literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期重点文献按发表日期、相关性、证据等级和研究质量综合排序，研究结果与综述证据分别核验后形成以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 为了应对这种持续存在的知识差距,我们的团队之前发现了一种免疫介导增强的新机制,我们将其称为 DENV 感染的 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 依赖性增强 (BDE)。 [10.1128/jvi.02216-25]
最新发现:登革热负担有所增加,特别是在儿童和青少年中,并且已扩展到以前未受影响的地区。 [10.1097/qco.0000000000001219]
由于超声检查观察到自发性改善,计划的经皮肝穿刺胆囊抽吸术被取消。 [PMID:42366785]
结果表明,血清型 1 历来占主导地位,但与前一年相比,2024 年 DENV-2 和 DENV-3 病例大幅增加。 [10.1007/s11262-026-02259-2]
对流行的 DENV 血清型的分析表明,年轻人、男性和中东原产地的发病率较高。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0351649]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分证据来自摘要、观察性研究或叙述性综述，结论应结合研究设计和证据等级理解。
literature.lead_en: This literature brief prioritizes publications in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency and source convergence.
key_findings_en: In response to this persistent knowledge gap, our team has previously identified a novel mechanism of immune-mediated enhancement we have termed B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of DENV infection. [10.1128/jvi.02216-25]
RECENT FINDINGS: Dengue burden has increased, particularly among children and adolescents, and it has expanded into previously unaffected regions. [10.1097/qco.0000000000001219]
Planned percutaneous transhepatic gallbladder aspiration was canceled because of spontaneous improvement observed on ultrasonography. [PMID:42366785]
The results indicated a historical predominance of serotype one, but with a considerable increase in DENV-2 and DENV-3 cases in 2024 compared to the previous year. [10.1007/s11262-026-02259-2]

literature.caveats_en: Some evidence is abstract-only, observational or derived from narrative reviews; conclusions should be interpreted in light of study design and evidence strength.

news.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期新闻资格由来源、日期、正文身份和相关性终审决定；中文翻译状态不影响有效新闻的保留。中文字段不可用时，本区域使用已核验英文内容填充。
key_findings_zh: 此次事件是武田制药的登革热QDENGA疫苗获得印度药品监管机构的批准,使其成为印度批准的首个登革热疫苗。这是该公司报告的已确认事件。 [news-69122ad722ad2c42]
印度药品监管机构批准了武田的 QDENGA,这是该国首款登革热疫苗,作为预防登革热病毒感染的工具。 [news-fd375c39109b4d2a]
卫生部于 2025 年 4 月 17 日正式宣布登革热疫情。该事件已确认为疫情,出现实验室确诊病例和死亡病例。IFRC 将回应记录在 DREF 最终报告 (MDRWS003) 中。 [news-9355099a0e513e3b]
据印度教局 2026 年 7 月 20 日报道,印度药品监管总局 (DCGI) 向武田生物制药印度公司的 QDENGA (TAK-003) 授予市场授权,这是印度批准的第一种登革热疫苗。 [news-abdb43497a12eb2b]
NHRI 和 NCKU 的研究小组报告了一种针对 CLEC5A 和 TLR2 受体的双特异性抗体的开发,可抑制登革热病毒感染中的严重炎症反应,显示出治疗严重登革热的潜力。另外,嘉义市政府卫生局证实一宗输入性登革热个案,涉及一名从越南回国的学生。 [news-ad5729082e962765]

key_findings_en: The event is the approval of Takeda Pharmaceutical's QDENGA vaccine for dengue fever by India's drug regulator, making it the first dengue vaccine approved in India. This is a confirmed event reported by the company. [news-69122ad722ad2c42]
India's drug regulator approved Takeda's QDENGA, the country's first dengue vaccine, as a preventive tool against dengue virus infection. [news-fd375c39109b4d2a]

The Ministry of Health officially declared a dengue fever outbreak on 17 April 2025. The event is confirmed as an outbreak with laboratory-confirmed cases and fatalities. The response was documented in a DREF Final Report (MDRWS003) by the IFRC. [news-9355099a0e513e3b]

The Drug Controller General of India (DCGI) granted market authorisation to Takeda Biopharmaceuticals India’s QDENGA (TAK-003), the first dengue vaccine approved in India, as reported by The Hindu Bureau on 20 July 2026. [news-abdb43497a12eb2b]

A research team from NHRI and NCKU reported the development of a bispecific antibody targeting CLEC5A and TLR2 receptors to suppress severe inflammatory responses in dengue virus infection, showing potential as a treatment for severe dengue fever. [news-ad5729082e962765]

papers.title: Unresolved questions in pediatric dengue: from disease mechanisms to prevention
papers.abstract: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Despite recent advances in understanding dengue infection, substantial gaps remain in its epidemiology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, and prevention, including vaccine development and its long-term impact. This review summarizes recent findings and highlights the most pressing research needs to advance the field and reduce individual and public health burden. RECENT FINDINGS: Dengue burden has increased, particularly among children and adolescents, and it has expanded into previously unaffected regions. Still, current data likely underestimates the true burden due to suboptimal surveillance systems. Improving control will require a better understanding of severe dengue pathogenesis, where key gaps remain, alongside reassessment of diagnostic limitations in the context of increasing vaccine availability. Vaccines represent an important complementary tool, with several candidates under study and two currently in use, each with distinct strengths, limitations, and unresolved questions. SUMMARY: More extensive research and investment are needed to address the growing burden of dengue, including severe outbreaks and geographic spread. papers.abstract_zh: 综述目的:尽管最近在了解登革热感染方面取得了进展,但在其流行病学、发病机制、诊断和预防(包括疫苗开发及其长期影响)方面仍存在很大差距。这篇综述总结了最近的研究结果,并强调了推进该领域并减轻个人和公共卫生负担的最紧迫的研究需求。最新发现:登革热负担有所增加,特别是在儿童和青少年中,并且已扩展到以前未受影响的地区。尽管如此,由于监测系统欠佳,当前数据可能低估了真正的负担。改善控制需要更好地了解严重登革热的发病机制,其中仍存在关键差距,同时在增加疫苗供应的情况下重新评估诊断局限性。疫苗是一种重要的补充工具,有几种候选疫苗正在研究中,两种目前正在使用,每种疫苗都有独特的优势、局限性和未解决的问题。摘要:需要更广泛的研究和投资来解决登革热日益严重的负担,包括严重的爆发和地理传播。与此同时,加强监管参与创新治疗和预防措施的制定和评估至关重要,特别是在负担最重的低收入和中等收入地区。关于登革热及其影响的清晰沟通和教育,以及经证明具有良好耐受性和有效性的可用预防措施,对于加强信任、提高吸收率和最大限度地提高公共卫生影响也至关重要。

papers.title: Epidemiological and genomic analysis of the dengue virus isolate from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia: Implications for future therapeutic development
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is one of the major mosquito-borne diseases worldwide, and studies have shown that more than half of the world population could be at risk of dengue in the future. To date, there are no universally effective vaccines or specific antiviral treatments for dengue virus (DENV). Dengue fever has reported in the Western region of Saudi Arabia since 1994. A comprehensive understanding of the molecular epidemiology of the DENV in Saudi Arabia, with implications for therapeutic development, is still absent. AIM: The present study aimed to integrate analysis of the circulating DENV genome and mutations of the most prevalent dengue serotype in the therapeutic context. METHODS: Retrospective data were used to conduct analysis of dengue infections in Jeddah city in Saudi Arabia from January to October 2024. All Saudis, non-Saudis, and Hajj and Umrah visitors with a confirmed diagnosis of dengue fever were included in the study. The demographic factors and DENV serotypes were explored. The genome of the most prevalent DENV serotype was sequenced using Oxford Nanopore Technology. Closely related strains were searched using the BLAST NCBI tool, and the NGPhylogeny server was used to analyze the phylogenetic relationship. In order to provide a biologically appropriate template for drug-design initiative, the dengue structural protein (prM) of an isolated strain was optimized through receptor modeling and mutation analysis using ICM tool. RESULTS: Analysis of the circulating DENV serotypes showed that higher incidence rates occurred in young adults, males, and from the Middle Eastern region of origin. The majority (95.3%) of confirmed cases were caused by the serotype DENV-2. A high nucleotide sequence identity was noted for strains originating from Pakistan (99.68%). Five ligands containing nitrogen-rich chemical scaffolds (piperidine, azoles, and sulfonamides) with a variety of substituents were identified by the study as possible binding hits to both wild-type and mutant prM receptor structures. Although of limited sample size and preliminary docking results, the epidemiological and molecular data generated in the study provide useful information for epidemic preparedness and possible therapeutic interventions.

papers.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯吉达登革热病毒分离株的流行病学和基因组分析:对未来治疗开发的影响
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is one of the major mosquito-borne diseases worldwide, and studies have shown that more than half of the world population could be at risk of dengue in the future. To date, there are no universally effective vaccines or specific antiviral treatments for dengue virus (DENV). Dengue fever has reported in the Western region of Saudi Arabia since 1994. A comprehensive understanding of the molecular epidemiology of the DENV in Saudi Arabia, with implications for therapeutic development, is still absent. AIM: The present study aimed to integrate analysis of the circulating DENV genome and mutations of the most prevalent dengue serotype in the therapeutic context. METHODS: Retrospective data were used to conduct analysis of dengue infections in Jeddah city in Saudi Arabia from January to October 2024. All Saudis, non-Saudis, and Hajj and Umrah visitors with a confirmed diagnosis of dengue fever were included in the study. The demographic factors and DENV serotypes were explored. The genome of the most prevalent DENV serotype was sequenced using Oxford Nanopore Technology. Closely related strains were searched using the BLAST NCBI tool, and the NGPhylogeny server was used to analyze the phylogenetic relationship. In order to provide a biologically appropriate template for drug-design initiative, the dengue structural protein (prM) of an isolated strain was optimized through receptor modeling and mutation analysis using ICM tool. RESULTS: Analysis of the circulating DENV serotypes showed that higher incidence rates occurred in young adults, males, and from the Middle Eastern region of origin. The majority (95.3%) of confirmed cases were caused by the serotype DENV-2. A high nucleotide sequence identity was noted for strains originating from Pakistan (99.68%). Five ligands containing nitrogen-rich chemical scaffolds (piperidine, azoles, and sulfonamides) with a variety of substituents were identified by the study as possible binding hits to both wild-type and mutant prM receptor structures. Although of limited sample size and preliminary docking results, the epidemiological and molecular data generated in the study provide useful information for epidemic preparedness and possible therapeutic interventions.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热是全球主要的蚊媒疾病之一,研究表明,未来世界上一半以上的人口可能面临登革热的风险。迄今为止,还没有针对登革热病毒(DENV)的普遍有效的疫苗或特异性抗病毒治疗方法。自 1994 年以来,沙特阿拉伯西部地区就有登革热报道。目前,人们对沙特阿拉伯登革热病毒的分子流行病学及其对治疗开发的影响尚缺乏全面的了解。目的:本研究旨在整合对治疗背景下循环登革热病毒基因组和最流行登革热血清型突变的分析。方法:采用回顾性数据对沙特阿拉伯吉达市2024年1月至10月登革热感染情况进行分析。所有确诊登革热的沙特人、非沙特人、朝觐和副朝游客均纳入研究。探讨了人口因素和 DENV 血清型。使用牛津纳米孔技术对最流行的 DENV 血清型的基因组进行了测序。使用BLAST NCBI工具搜索密切相关的菌株,并使用NGPhylogeny服务器分析系统发育关系。为了为药物设计方案提供生物学上合适的模板,使用 ICM 工具通过受体建模和突变分析对分离菌株的登革热结构蛋白 (prM) 进行了优化。结果:对流行的 DENV 血清型的分析表明,年轻人、男性和中东原产地的发病率较高。大多数(95.3%)确诊病例是由DENV-2血清型引起的。来自巴基斯坦的菌株具有较高的核苷酸序列同一性(99.68%)。研究鉴定出五种含有富氮化学支架(哌啶、唑类和磺酰胺)以及多种取代基的配体,它们可能与野生型和突变型 prM 受体结构结合。尽管样本量和初步对接结果有限,但研究中产生的流行病学和分子数据为流行病防范和可能的治疗干预措施提供了有用的信息。

papers.title: Congenital Dengue Infection during the Epidemic in Argentina in the 2023-2024 Period: A Multicenter Registry.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To describe clinical, laboratory, and follow-up characteristics of neonates with confirmed dengue infection. STUDY DESIGN: Observational, descriptive, retrospective, and multicenter study including neonates with confirmed congenital dengue hospitalized at six centers from Argentina, between July 2023 and July 2024. Confirmation required virological or serological testing in both mother and neonate. Data were collected anonymously via REDCap and analyzed with RStudio. RESULTS: A total of 58 neonates were included. Most pregnant individuals presented with fever, myalgia, and headache. Maternal diagnosis was confirmed mainly by NS1 antigen (59%) and PCR (43%); 9% were serotyped, with 4⁄5 serotypes corresponding to DENV1. In all 52 pregnant individuals were hospitalized. Median gestational age at birth was 38 weeks, and 21% of neonates were preterm. Most deliveries were cesarean. At admission, 74% of neonates were asymptomatic; 26% showed respiratory distress or temperature instability. Diagnosis was confirmed by PCR in 59% of neonates. Two preterm neonates required mechanical ventilation. Median hospital stay was 9 days. Within the first week of life, 57% of neonates developed thrombocytopenia. No deaths or sequelae were recorded in neonates. One mother died because of severe dengue with shock. CONCLUSION: In this multicenter registry, 74% of neonates were asymptomatic and 21% preterm, with no deaths or sequelae at discharge and 30 days of follow-up. KEY POINTS: · In 98% of pregnant individuals with dengue infection was mild, and one died.. · About 74% of neonates with congenital dengue were asymptomatic.. · Thrombocytopenia was seen in 57% of neonates within the first week of life with a peak at day 7..

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:描述确诊登革热感染新生儿的临床、实验室和随访特征。研究设计:观察性、描述性、回顾性和多中心研究,包括 2023 年 7 月至 2024 年 7 月期间在阿根廷六个中心住院的确诊先天性登革热的新生儿。确认需要对母亲和新生儿进行病毒学或血清学检测。数据通过 REDCap 匿名收集并使用 RStudio 进行分析。结果:共纳入 58 名新生儿。大多数孕妇会出现发烧、肌痛和头痛的症状。产妇诊断主要通过NS1抗原(59%)和PCR(43%)确诊;9% 进行了血清分型,其中 4⁄5 血清型对应于 DENV1。共有 52 名孕妇住院。出生时中位孕周为 38 周,21% 的新生儿早产。大多数分娩都是剖腹产。入院时,74%的新生儿没有症状;26% 的人表现出呼吸困难或体温不稳定。59% 的新生儿通过 PCR 确诊。两名早产新生儿需要机械通气。中位住院时间为 9 天。在出生后的第一周内,57% 的新生儿出现血小板减少症。没有新生儿死亡或后遗症的记录。一位母亲因严重登革热休克而死亡。结论:在这项多中心登记中,74% 的新生儿无症状,21% 为早产儿,出院时和 30 天的随访中没有死亡或后遗症。要点: · 98% 的孕妇感染登革热症状较轻,其中一人死亡。· 约 74% 的先天性登革热新生儿无症状。· 57% 的新生儿在出生后第一周出现血小板减少症,第 7 天达到高峰。

papers.title: Rising dengue burden in high-altitude central Nepal: evidence from a population-based longitudinal serosurvey, 2019-2023
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue is intensifying globally due to climate change, urbanization, and land use changes. In Nepal, dengue has expanded from lowland regions to higher altitudes, with record outbreaks in 2022 and 2023. However, reliance on passive surveillance and hospital-based studies may underestimate community level infection burden. Methods We conducted a population-based serologic cohort study in Kathmandu and Kavrepalanchok districts, Nepal, enrolling a geographically representative, age stratified random sample of residents aged 0 to 25 years from pre-defined hospital catchment areas. Enrollment occurred in two phases: Phase I (February 2019 to April 2021) with follow-up visits at approximately 3, 6, and 12 months, and Phase II (February to June 2023) revisiting the original cohort. At each household visit, we collected capillary blood samples by finger-prick onto filter paper and tested the samples for IgG responses against dengue-derived recombinant antigen using InBios DENV DetectTM ELISA. Serostatus was classified using the manufacturer's recommended immune status ratio (ISR) cutoffs. We calculated seroprevalence at each time point and estimated seroincidence rates by identifying seroconversion events per 1,000 person-years. We assessed risk factors using multivariable regression models. Results Between 2019 and 2023, we enrolled 840 participants and collected 2,082 blood samples. The overall seroincidence rate was 33.8 per 1,000 person-years (95% CI [24.9 to 45.0]), with the highest rates in urban Kathmandu ([105.7], 95% CI [75.1 to 144.4]). Seroincidence increased with age and over time from 46.1 in 2019 to 51.0 in 2023. Participants living with a dengue-positive individual in the same household (adjusted RR [4.65], 95% CI [2.72 to 8.0]) and households with water-filled flower basins (adjusted RR [2.53], 95% CI [1.28 to 5.74]) had significantly higher risk of seroconversion. Conclusions This study reveals a significant and increasing burden of dengue infection in the Kathmandu Valley between 2019 and 2023. highlighting an urgent need for immediate public health interventions to mitigate dengue's rise in Nepal's higher-altitude regions.

papers.title_zh: 尼泊尔中部高海拔地区登革热负担上升:来自 2019-2023 年基于人群的纵向血清调查的证据
papers.source_body_en: Background: Dengue is intensifying globally due to climate change, urbanization, and land use changes. In Nepal, dengue has expanded from lowland regions to higher altitudes, with record outbreaks in 2022 and 2023. However, reliance on passive surveillance and hospital-based studies may underestimate community level infection burden. Methods We conducted a population-based serologic cohort study in Kathmandu and Kavrepalanchok districts, Nepal, enrolling a geographically representative, age stratified random sample of residents aged 0 to 25 years from pre-defined hospital catchment areas. Enrollment occurred in two phases: Phase I (February 2019 to April 2021) with follow-up visits at approximately 3, 6, and 12 months, and Phase II (February to June 2023) revisiting the original cohort. At each household visit, we collected capillary blood samples by finger-prick onto filter paper and tested the samples for IgG responses against dengue-derived recombinant antigen using InBios DENV DetectTM ELISA. Serostatus was classified using the manufacturer's recommended immune status ratio (ISR) cutoffs. We calculated seroprevalence at each time point and estimated seroincidence rates by identifying seroconversion events per 1,000 person-years. We assessed risk factors using multivariable regression models. Results Between 2019 and 2023, we enrolled 840 participants and collected 2,082 blood samples. The overall seroincidence rate was 33.8 per 1,000 person-years (95% CI [24.9 to 45.0]), with the highest rates in urban Kathmandu ([105.7], 95% CI [75.1 to 144.4]). Seroincidence increased with age and over time from 46.1 in 2019 to 51.0 in 2023. Participants living with a dengue-positive individual in the same household (adjusted RR [4.65], 95% CI [2.72 to 8.0]) and households with water-filled flower basins (adjusted RR [2.53], 95% CI [1.28 to 5.74]) had significantly higher risk of seroconversion. Conclusions This study reveals a significant and increasing burden of dengue infection in the Kathmandu Valley between 2019 and 2023. highlighting an urgent need for immediate public health interventions to mitigate dengue's rise in Nepal's higher-altitude regions.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:由于气候变化、城市化和土地利用变化,登革热在全球范围内加剧。在尼泊尔,登革热已从低地地区扩展到高海拔地区,并于 2022 年和 2023 年爆发创纪录的疫情。然而,依赖被动监测和医院研究可能会低估社区层面的感染负担。方法 我们在尼泊尔加德满都和 Kavrepalanchok 地区开展了一项基于人群的血清学队列研究,从预先确定的医院服务区域招募了具有地理代表性、年龄分层的 0 至 25 岁居民随机样本。入组分两个阶段进行:第一阶段(2019 年 2 月至 2021 年 4 月),在约 3、6 和 12 个月进行随访;第二阶段(2023 年 2 月至 2023 年 6 月)重新访问原始队列。每次入户访问时,我们通过手指刺破滤纸收集毛细血管血样,并使用 InBios DENV DetectTM ELISA 测试样本针对登革热衍生重组抗原的 IgG 反应。使用制造商推荐的免疫状态比 (ISR) 临界值对血清状态进行分类。我们计算了每个时间点的血清阳性率,并通过识别每 1,000 人年的血清转化事件来估计血清发病率。我们使用多变量回归模型评估风险因素。结果 2019 年至 2023 年间,我们招募了 840 名参与者并收集了 2,082 份血液样本。总体血清发病率为每 1,000 人年 33.8 例(95% CI [24.9 - 45.0]),加德满都市区的发病率最高([105.7],95% CI [75.1 - 144.4])。血清发病率随着年龄和时间的推移而增加,从 2019 年的 46.1 增加到 2023 年的 51.0。与登革热阳性个体生活在同一家庭的参与者(调整后的 RR [4.65],95% CI [2.72 至 8.0])和有充满水的花盆的家庭(调整后的 RR [2.53],95% CI [1.28 至 5.74])血清转化的风险明显较高。结论 这项研究揭示了 2019 年至 2023 年间加德满都谷地登革热感染负担显着且不断增加。强调迫切需要立即采取公共卫生干预措施,以减缓尼泊尔高海拔地区登革热的上升。

papers.title: Disruption of carbon metabolism by the hepatic mononuclear phagocytic system drives liver injury in a mouse model of severe dengue.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Severe dengue (SD) is the leading cause of morbidity and mortality resulting from dengue virus (DENV) infection, with liver injury being one of the most common complications. However, besides symptomatic treatment, there is currently no targeted therapy, and the specific mechanism underlying liver injury in SD remains elusive. This study aimed to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying liver injury in SD to facilitate the development of prophylactic and therapeutic interventions. METHODS: To systematically characterize dynamic liver lesions in an SD mouse model, we employed multi-omics techniques, including bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq), proteomics, phosphoproteomics, and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq). Subsequently, we validated the mRNA and protein expression levels of the screened target molecules by quantitative PCR (qPCR), Western blot (WB), Luminex multiplex assays, and immunofluorescence (IF) assays. To this end, a co-culture system of DENV-infected macrophages and hepatocytes was employed. RESULTS: Beyond the inflammatory response, multi-omics analysis revealed disruption of carbon metabolism in hepatocytes across multiple time points. Disrupted cell-cell communication between hepatocytes and the hepatic mononuclear phagocytic system (HMPS) contributed to carbon metabolic dysfunction. To elucidate the underlying mechanism, we administered fostamatinib, which effectively inhibited the abnormally activated Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK)-mediated signaling pathway in HMPS. This intervention ameliorated carbon metabolism disorders and significantly alleviated liver injury in SD mice. CONCLUSIONS: Fostamatinib demonstrated significant efficacy in mitigating liver injury induced by DENV infection, while concurrently alleviating inflammatory responses and ameliorating carbon metabolism disorders. IMPACT AND IMPLICATIONS: Severe dengue, often accompanied by varying degrees of hepatic impairment, constitutes a primary cause of DENV-associated mortality. However, current specific therapeutic interventions remain inadequate. This study demonstrates that the cellular communication between the HMPS and hepatocytes is altered, thereby disrupting carbon metabolic functions in hepatocytes. The administration of fostamatinib ameliorated hepatic carbon metabolic disorders and liver injury. This provides a theoretical foundation for the development of therapeutic interventions targeting hepatic injury in severe dengue.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 严重登革热(SD)是发病率和死亡率的主要原因,肝损伤是一种常见的并发症,但这种损伤的具体机制仍然难以捉摸,也没有针对性的治疗方法。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用小鼠模型,采用多组学技术以及 DENV 感染的巨噬细胞和肝细胞的共培养系统,研究了 SD 肝损伤的分子机制。
elements_zh.methods: 多组学技术,包括批量 RNA 测序、蛋白质组学、磷酸化蛋白质组学和单细胞 RNA 测序,用于表征动态肝脏病变,并通过 qPCR、Western blot、Luminex 多重分析和免疫荧光分析对靶分子进行验证。
elements_zh.main_results: 多组学分析揭示了肝细胞中碳代谢的破坏,以及肝细胞和肝单核吞噬系统(HMPS)之间细胞间通讯的破坏导致了这种代谢功能障碍。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,HMPS 和肝细胞之间的细胞通讯发生改变,破坏碳代谢功能,而福斯塔替尼可改善这些疾病和肝损伤。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为开发针对严重登革热肝损伤的治疗干预措施提供了理论基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于小鼠模型和体外共培养系统,这可能会限制研究结果对人类患者的直接推广。

papers.title_zh: 肝脏单核吞噬系统对碳代谢的破坏导致严重登革热小鼠模型的肝损伤。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Severe dengue (SD) is the leading cause of morbidity and mortality resulting from dengue virus (DENV) infection, with liver injury being one of the most common complications. However, besides symptomatic treatment, there is currently no targeted therapy, and the specific mechanism underlying liver injury in SD remains elusive. This study aimed to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying liver injury in SD to facilitate the development of prophylactic and therapeutic interventions. METHODS: To systematically characterize dynamic liver lesions in an SD mouse model, we employed multi-omics techniques, including bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq), proteomics, phosphoproteomics, and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq). Subsequently, we validated the mRNA and protein expression levels of the screened target molecules by quantitative PCR (qPCR), Western blot (WB), Luminex multiplex assays, and immunofluorescence (IF) assays. To this end, a co-culture system of DENV-infected macrophages and hepatocytes was employed. RESULTS: Beyond the inflammatory response, multi-omics analysis revealed disruption of carbon metabolism in hepatocytes across multiple time points. Disrupted cell-cell communication between hepatocytes and the hepatic mononuclear phagocytic system (HMPS) contributed to carbon metabolic dysfunction. To elucidate the underlying mechanism, we administered fostamatinib, which effectively inhibited the abnormally activated Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK)-mediated signaling pathway in HMPS. This intervention ameliorated carbon metabolism disorders and significantly alleviated liver injury in SD mice. CONCLUSIONS: Fostamatinib demonstrated significant efficacy in mitigating liver injury induced by DENV infection, while concurrently alleviating inflammatory responses and ameliorating carbon metabolism disorders. IMPACT AND IMPLICATIONS: Severe dengue, often accompanied by varying degrees of hepatic impairment, constitutes a primary cause of DENV-associated mortality. However, current specific therapeutic interventions remain inadequate. This study demonstrates that the cellular communication between the HMPS and hepatocytes is altered, thereby disrupting carbon metabolic functions in hepatocytes. The administration of fostamatinib ameliorated hepatic carbon metabolic disorders and liver injury. This provides a theoretical foundation for the development of therapeutic interventions targeting hepatic injury in severe dengue.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景与目的:重症登革热(SD)是登革热病毒(DENV)感染导致发病和死亡的主要原因,肝损伤是最常见的并发症之一。然而,除了对症治疗外,目前尚无靶向治疗,且SD肝损伤的具体机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨 SD 肝损伤的分子机制,以促进预防和治疗干预措施的开发。方法:为了系统地表征 SD 小鼠模型中的动态肝脏病变,我们采用了多组学技术,包括批量 RNA 测序 (RNA-Seq)、蛋白质组学、磷酸化蛋白质组学和单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq)。随后,我们通过定量 PCR (qPCR)、Western blot (WB)、Luminex 多重检测和免疫荧光 (IF) 检测验证了筛选的靶分子的 mRNA 和蛋白表达水平。为此,采用了感染 DENV 的巨噬细胞和肝细胞的共培养系统。结果:除了炎症反应之外,多组学分析还揭示了多个时间点肝细胞碳代谢的破坏。肝细胞和肝单核吞噬系统(HMPS)之间的细胞间通讯中断导致碳代谢功能障碍。为了阐明潜在的机制,我们给予了福斯塔替尼,它有效地抑制了 HMPS 中异常激活的布鲁顿酪氨酸激酶 (BTK) 介导的信号通路。这种干预改善了 SD 小鼠的碳代谢紊乱并显着减轻了肝损伤。结论:Fostamatinib 在减轻 DENV 感染引起的肝损伤方面具有显着疗效,同时减轻炎症反应和改善碳代谢紊乱。影响和意义:严重登革热通常伴有不同程度的肝损伤,是登革热病毒相关死亡的主要原因。然而,目前的具体治疗干预措施仍然不足。这项研究表明,HMPS 和肝细胞之间的细胞通讯发生了改变,从而破坏了肝细胞中的碳代谢功能。福斯塔替尼的给药可改善肝脏碳代谢紊乱和肝损伤。这为开发针对严重登革热肝损伤的治疗干预措施提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Molecular and biophysical requirements for B cell receptor-dependent enhancement of dengue virus infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) is the causative agent of dengue, a mosquito-borne disease that represents a significant and growing public health burden around the world. A unique pathophysiological feature of dengue is immune-mediated enhancement, wherein preexisting immunity elicited by a primary infection can enhance the severity of a subsequent infection by a heterologous DENV serotype. A leading mechanistic explanation for this phenomenon is antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), where sub-neutralizing concentrations of DENV-specific IgG antibodies facilitate the entry of DENV into FcγR-expressing cells. Accordingly, this model posits that phagocytic mononuclear cells are the primary reservoir of DENV. However, multiple independent groups have shown that B cells are the largest reservoir of virally infected cells in circulation during acute dengue, representing a disconnect in our understanding of immune-mediated DENV tropism. In response to this persistent knowledge gap, our team has previously identified a novel mechanism of immune-mediated enhancement we have termed B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of DENV infection. In this study, we show that DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells is highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. DENV entry into this subset of B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Finally, we show that immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are productively infected by live DENV, capable of supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes. We propose that BDE provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE and offers additional insight into potential mechanisms of DENV immunopathogenesis. IMPORTANCE This study provides mechanistic insight into the process of B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Immune-mediated enhancement of infection is a cornerstone of dengue immunopathogenesis and is most often attributed to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). BCR-dependent enhancement of DENV infection is an alternative and complementary mechanism for immune-mediated enhancement that addresses several persistent knowledge gaps in the dengue field and may offer mechanistic insight into why some people progress to severe dengue after infection.

papers.title_zh: B细胞受体依赖性增强登革热病毒感染的分子和生物物理要求
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) is the causative agent of dengue, a mosquito-borne disease that represents a significant and growing public health burden around the world. A unique pathophysiological feature of dengue is immune-mediated enhancement, wherein preexisting immunity elicited by a primary infection can enhance the severity of a subsequent infection by a heterologous DENV serotype. A leading mechanistic explanation for this phenomenon is antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), where sub-neutralizing concentrations of DENV-specific IgG antibodies facilitate the entry of DENV into FcγR-expressing cells. Accordingly, this model posits that phagocytic mononuclear cells are the primary reservoir of DENV. However, multiple independent groups have shown that B cells are the largest reservoir of virally infected cells in circulation during acute dengue, representing a disconnect in our understanding of immune-mediated DENV tropism. In response to this persistent knowledge gap, our team has previously identified a novel mechanism of immune-mediated enhancement we have termed B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of DENV infection. In this study, we show that DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells is highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. DENV entry into this subset of B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Finally, we show that immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are productively infected by live DENV, capable of supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes. We propose that BDE provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE and offers additional insight into potential mechanisms of DENV immunopathogenesis. IMPORTANCE This study provides mechanistic insight into the process of B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Immune-mediated enhancement of infection is a cornerstone of dengue immunopathogenesis and is most often attributed to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). BCR-dependent enhancement of DENV infection is an alternative and complementary mechanism for immune-mediated enhancement that addresses several persistent knowledge gaps in the dengue field and may offer mechanistic insight into why some people progress to severe dengue after infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热病毒 (DENV) 是登革热的病原体,登革热是一种蚊媒疾病,给全世界带来了巨大且日益严重的公共卫生负担。登革热的一个独特的病理生理学特征是免疫介导的增强,其中由原发感染引起的预先存在的免疫力可以增强异源DENV血清型的后续感染的严重性。这种现象的一个主要机制解释是抗体依赖性增强(ADE),其中亚中和浓度的 DENV 特异性 IgG 抗体有利于 DENV 进入表达 FcγR 的细胞。因此,该模型假设吞噬性单核细胞是 DENV 的主要储存库。然而,多个独立研究小组表明,B 细胞是急性登革热期间循环中最大的病毒感染细胞库,这表明我们对免疫介导的 DENV 趋向性的理解存在脱节。为了应对这种持续存在的知识差距,我们的团队之前发现了一种免疫介导增强的新机制,我们将其称为 DENV 感染的 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 依赖性增强 (BDE)。在这项研究中,我们发现 DENV 反应性 B 细胞的 DENV 感染对 BCR/DENV 包膜 (E) 蛋白相互作用高度敏感。DENV 进入 B 细胞亚群是由动力介导的,需要近端 BCR 信号传导,并涉及晚期内体的定位。最后,我们证明永生化的 DENV 反应性 B 细胞可以被活 DENV 有效感染,能够支持所有四种血清型的活跃病毒复制。我们认为,BDE 提供了一层额外的病原体特异性免疫介导的感染风险,补充了现有的 ADE 模型,并为 DENV 免疫发病机制的潜在机制提供了更多见解。重要性 这项研究为 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 依赖性增强登革热病毒 (DENV) 感染的过程提供了机制见解。免疫介导的感染增强是登革热免疫发病机制的基石,最常归因于抗体依赖性增强(ADE)。DENV 感染的 BCR 依赖性增强是免疫介导增强的一种替代和补充机制,它解决了登革热领域中几个持续存在的知识空白,并可能为为什么有些人在感染后发展为严重登革热提供机制见解。

papers.title: Molecular characterization and recent spread of dengue virus type 3 lineage III_B.3.2 in Brazil: in silico analysis of protein motifs and epidemiology
papers.abstract: Abstract The dengue virus (DENV) belongs to the Flaviviridae family and is responsible for a febrile arbovirus disease of global relevance. In Brazil, there has been endemic circulation of the four viral serotypes since the last century, with DENV-3 being frequently associated with more severe clinical conditions and major epidemics. This study aimed to perform the motif characterization of DENV-3 strains circulating in Brazil and its epidemiology. We obtained cases information by serotype from DATASUS/TABNET from 2013 to 2025. Furthermore, 184 complete genomes of Brazilian samples available in the GenBank and GISAID databases were analyzed with the genome reference sequence of DENV-3 (NC_001475.2). The sequences were edited and analyzed with the MAFFT, BioEdit, Nextclade, and GeneDoc software to identify lineages and amino acid motifs and were subsequently submitted to phylogenetic analyses in the IQ-Tree and FigTree programs. The results indicated a historical predominance of serotype one, but with a considerable increase in DENV-2 and DENV-3 cases in 2024 compared to the previous year. By December 2025, DENV-3 cases had already surpassed those of DENV-1 for that year. Nine amino acid motifs were identified throughout the genome, especially sites of N-myristoylation, casein kinase II phosphorylation, protein kinase C phosphorylation, and N-glycosylation. The predominant lineages were 3III_C.2 and 3III_C.2.2 until 2022, when lineage 3III_B.3.2 was introduced in Brazil, being associated with the increase in cases. This genotype presented substitutions and the absence of protein motifs compared to previous lineages, suggesting that such alterations contributed to its replicative success.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热病毒(DENV)属于黄病毒科,是一种全球性的发热性虫媒病毒病。在巴西,自上世纪以来,四种病毒血清型一直在流行,其中 DENV-3 经常与更严重的临床病症和重大流行病相关。本研究旨在对巴西流行的 DENV-3 菌株进行基序表征及其流行病学。我们从 DATASUS/TABNET 中获取了 2013 年至 2025 年按血清型分类的病例信息。此外,利用 DENV-3 的基因组参考序列(NC_001475.2)对 GenBank 和 GISAID 数据库中提供的 184 个巴西样本的完整基因组进行了分析。使用 MAFFT、BioEdit、Nextclade 和 GeneDoc 软件对序列进行编辑和分析,以识别谱系和氨基酸基序,然后提交到 IQ-Tree 和 FigTree 程序中进行系统发育分析。结果表明,血清型 1 历来占主导地位,但与前一年相比,2024 年 DENV-2 和 DENV-3 病例大幅增加。到2025年12月,DENV-3病例数已超过当年的DENV-1病例数。在整个基因组中鉴定出九个氨基酸基序,特别是 N-肉豆蔻酰化、酪蛋白激酶 II 磷酸化、蛋白激酶 C 磷酸化和 N-糖基化位点。直到 2022 年,主要谱系是 3III_C.2 和 3III_C.2.2,当时巴西引入了 3III_B.3.2 谱系,这与病例的增加有关。与之前的谱系相比,该基因型出现了替换并且缺乏蛋白质基序,表明这种改变有助于其复制成功。

papers.title: Microspatial partitioning of insect-specific viromes and dengue virus transmission risk by Aedes aegypt i in Puerto Rico
papers.abstract: Abstract Mosquito-borne arboviruses remain a major global health threat. Although insect-specific viruses (ISVs) may influence arbovirus transmission across geographic regions, their diversity within Aedes aegypti populations at microspatial scales remains poorly understood. We hypothesized that local environmental variation shapes the A. aegypti core virome, producing distinct ISV profiles in rural and urban populations in Puerto Rico. Metatranscriptomic RNA sequencing of F0 mosquitoes identified thirteen ISVs with habitat-specific virome composition. Partitiviridae was the dominant viral family, while Humaita-Tubiacanga virus (HTV) and Phasi Charoen-like phasivirus (PCLV) exhibited the highest abundance, persistence, and prevalence in urban laboratory colonies. aegypti also showed significantly higher dengue virus-1 (DENV-1) infection rates than rural populations, although saliva positivity remained low and did not differ significantly between the two groups. These findings indicate that microspatial ecological variation shapes the A. aegypti virome, but the association of HTV/PCLV with DENV-1 transmission risk is likely multifactorial and nuanced.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Mosquito-borne arboviruses pose a major global health threat, yet the diversity of insect-specific viruses (ISVs) within Aedes aegypti populations at microspatial scales and their potential influence on arbovirus transmission remain poorly understood. The study aimed to determine whether local environmental variation shapes the Aedes aegypti core virome and whether distinct ISV profiles in rural and urban populations correlate with dengue virus transmission risk.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed wild-caught and laboratory-colony Aedes aegypti mosquitoes from rural and urban sites in Puerto Rico using metatranscriptomic RNA sequencing of F0 mosquitoes. Urban laboratory colonies were included alongside field populations to assess habitat-specific virome composition and persistence.
analysis.methods: Metatranscriptomic RNA sequencing was performed on F0 Aedes aegypti mosquitoes to identify ISVs and characterize virome composition. Viral abundance, persistence, and prevalence were quantified, and infection rates for dengue virus-1 (DENV-1) were compared between rural and urban populations.
analysis.main_results: Thirteen ISVs were identified, with Partitiviridae as the dominant viral family. Humaita-Tubiacanga virus (HTV) and Phasi Charoen-like phasivirus (PCLV) exhibited the highest abundance, persistence, and prevalence in urban laboratory colonies. Aedes aegypti from urban areas showed significantly higher DENV-1 infection rates than rural populations, though saliva positivity for DENV-1 did not differ significantly between groups.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate that microspatial ecological variation shapes the Aedes aegypti virome, with urban environments favoring specific ISVs such as HTV and PCLV. The study highlights that the association between these ISVs and DENV-1 transmission risk is likely multifactorial and nuanced rather than directly causal.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that monitoring ISV profiles in Aedes aegypti populations could inform dengue risk assessment at local scales, particularly in urban settings where certain ISVs are more prevalent. This may guide targeted vector control strategies and surveillance efforts to mitigate arbovirus transmission.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and reliance on laboratory colonies for urban comparisons, which may not fully represent field conditions. The evidence is moderate, as saliva positivity for DENV-1 did not differ significantly despite higher infection rates in urban mosquitoes, indicating potential confounding or unmeasured factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether microspatial ecological variation in Puerto Rico shapes the insect-specific virome (ISV) of Aedes aegypti and influences dengue virus transmission risk. Using metatranscriptomic RNA sequencing of F0 mosquitoes, thirteen ISVs were identified, with Partitiviridae dominating and Humaita-Tubiacanga virus (HTV) and Phasi Charoen-like phasivirus (PCLV) showing highest abundance, persistence, and prevalence in urban laboratory colonies. Urban Aedes aegypti exhibited significantly higher dengue virus-1 (DENV-1) infection rates than rural populations, though saliva positivity did not differ significantly. The findings suggest that urban environments favor specific ISVs, but their association with DENV-1 transmission risk is multifactorial. These results imply that monitoring ISV profiles could inform local dengue risk assessment and vector control strategies, particularly in urban settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 蚊媒病毒对全球健康构成重大威胁,但埃及伊蚊种群内微空间尺度的昆虫特异性病毒(ISV)的多样性及其对虫媒病毒传播的潜在影响仍然知之甚少。该研究旨在确定当地环境变化是否影响埃及伊蚊核心病毒组,以及农村和城市人群中不同的 ISV 特征是否与登革热病毒传播风险相关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用 F0 代蚊子的宏转录组 RNA 测序分析了波多黎各农村和城市地区的野生埃及伊蚊和实验室群体埃及伊蚊。城市实验室菌落与野外种群一起被纳入,以评估栖息地特定的病毒组组成和持久性。
elements_zh.methods: 对 F0 埃及伊蚊进行宏转录组 RNA 测序,以鉴定 ISV 并表征病毒组组成。对病毒丰度、持久性和流行率进行了量化,并比较了农村和城市人群的登革热病毒 1 (DENV-1) 感染率。
elements_zh.main_results: 已鉴定出 13 种 ISV,其中 Partitiviridae 是主要病毒家族。Humaita-Tubiacanga 病毒 (HTV) 和 Phasi Charoen 样 phasivirus (PCLV) 在城市实验室群体中表现出最高的丰度、持久性和流行率。来自城市地区的埃及伊蚊的 DENV-1 感染率明显高于农村人口,尽管各组之间 DENV-1 唾液阳性率没有显着差异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,微空间生态变化塑造了埃及伊蚊病毒组,城市环境有利于特定的 ISV,例如 HTV 和 PCLV。该研究强调,这些 ISV 与 DENV-1 传播风险之间的关联可能是多因素且微妙的,而不是直接因果关系。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,监测埃及伊蚊种群中的 ISV 特征可以为当地规模的登革热风险评估提供信息,特别是在某些 ISV 更为普遍的城市环境中。这可以指导有针对性的病媒控制策略和监测工作,以减轻虫媒病毒的传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其横截面设计和对城市比较实验室群体的依赖而受到限制,这可能无法完全代表实地条件。证据是中等的,因为尽管城市蚊子的感染率较高,但 DENV-1 唾液阳性率没有显着差异,这表明存在潜在的混杂因素或未测量的因素。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 蚊媒病毒对全球健康构成重大威胁,但埃及伊蚊种群内微空间尺度的昆虫特异性病毒(ISV)的多样性及其对虫媒病毒传播的潜在影响仍然知之甚少。该研究旨在确定当地环境变化是否影响埃及伊蚊核心病毒组,以及农村和城市人群中不同的 ISV 特征是否与登革热病毒传播风险相关。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用 F0 代蚊子的宏转录组 RNA 测序分析了波多黎各农村和城市地区的野生埃及伊蚊和实验室群体埃及伊蚊。城市实验室菌落与野外种群一起被纳入,以评估栖息地特定的病毒组组成和持久性。
analysis_zh.methods: 对 F0 埃及伊蚊进行宏转录组 RNA 测序,以鉴定 ISV 并表征病毒组组成。对病毒丰度、持久性和流行率进行了量化,并比较了农村和城市人群的登革热病毒 1 (DENV-1) 感染率。
analysis_zh.main_results: 已鉴定出 13 种 ISV,其中 Partitiviridae 是主要病毒家族。Humaita-Tubiacanga 病毒 (HTV) 和 Phasi Charoen 样 phasivirus (PCLV) 在城市实验室群体中表现出最高的丰度、持久性和流行率。来自城市地区的埃及伊蚊的 DENV-1 感染率明显高于农村人口,尽管各组之间 DENV-1 唾液阳性率没有显着差异。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,微空间生态变化塑造了埃及伊蚊病毒组,城市环境有利于特定的 ISV,例如 HTV 和 PCLV。该研究强调,这些 ISV 与 DENV-1 传播风险之间的关联可能是多因素且微妙的,而不是直接因果关系。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,监测埃及伊蚊种群中的 ISV 特征可以为当地规模的登革热风险评估提供信息,特别是在某些 ISV 更为普遍的城市环境中。这可以指导有针对性的病媒控制策略和监测工作,以减轻虫媒病毒的传播。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其横截面设计和对城市比较实验室群体的依赖而受到限制,这可能无法完全代表实地条件。证据是中等的,因为尽管城市蚊子的感染率较高,但 DENV-1 唾液阳性率没有显着差异,这表明存在潜在的混杂因素或未测量的因素。

papers.title: Combining vaccination with w Mel for dengue control in Brazil
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue virus is a severe threat to global health. Novel vaccine and Wolbachia technologies offer a potential path to dengue control; however, it remains unclear how to use these approaches in tandem. Using metapopulation transmission models, we simulated future dengue burden in Brazil. We estimated that w Mel releases in 300 municipalities could avert 12-22% of cases over the next 10 years, while a national vaccination campaign could avert 8-10% of cases in the total population and 39-45% within the vaccinated cohort. Projecting forward 40 years, we found w Mel releases would drive up the mean age of cases beyond increases due to the ageing population and increase population susceptibility to dengue. Finally, w Mel releases can help mitigate the future burden in southern Brazil where climate change is rapidly increasing dengue virus risk. These findings highlight the need to consider the two technologies in parallel to optimise efforts to combat future dengue burden.

papers.title_zh: 在巴西将疫苗接种与 w Mel 结合起来控制登革热
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Dengue virus is a severe threat to global health. Novel vaccine and Wolbachia technologies offer a potential path to dengue control; however, it remains unclear how to use these approaches in tandem. Using metapopulation transmission models, we simulated future dengue burden in Brazil. We estimated that w Mel releases in 300 municipalities could avert 12-22% of cases over the next 10 years, while a national vaccination campaign could avert 8-10% of cases in the total population and 39-45% within the vaccinated cohort. Projecting forward 40 years, we found w Mel releases would drive up the mean age of cases beyond increases due to the ageing population and increase population susceptibility to dengue. Finally, w Mel releases can help mitigate the future burden in southern Brazil where climate change is rapidly increasing dengue virus risk. These findings highlight the need to consider the two technologies in parallel to optimise efforts to combat future dengue burden.

papers.title: Precision repurposing of clinically characterized molecules targeting dengue virus RNA-dependent RNA polymerase: an in silico identification and in vitro validation
papers.abstract: The dengue virus has developed an effective replication mechanism that enables rapid viral replication in human hosts. The use of a molecular bottleneck offers an ideal approach for antiviral intervention, especially when no clinically authorized antivirals are available against dengue. The replication process is challenging due to functional redundancy. One of the core antiviral targets is the viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), a conserved and essential component of the DENV replication machinery with no mammalian homolog, which represents a promising target for antiviral intervention. This study employed a multi-tiered drug repurposing approach integrating computational screening, high-throughput virtual screening (HTVS), standard precision (SP), and extra precision (XP) molecular docking of SelleckChem FDA-approved & Passed Phase I Drug Library compounds against the DENV RdRp (PDB:5K5M), followed by 200 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, free binding energy analysis, free energy landscape (FEL) analysis, and in vitro antiviral validation. From the screening cascade, Proanthocyanidin and Stachyose were identified as lead candidates with Glide XP docking scores of -11.34 and - 13.08 kcal/mol and Molecular Mechanics/Generated Born Surface Area (MM-GBSA) binding free energies of -52.35 ± 5.29 kcal/mol, respectively. These lead candidates established stable interactions with important catalytic and regulatory residues, including Arg 729 , Thr 794 , Ser 796 , Asp 664 , and Tyr 766, indicating their ability to disrupt key polymerase activity. The stability of the candidates was further confirmed by Molecular dynamics simulations based on the minimal variations of RMSD and compactness of the protein compared with the lead structures, which collectively indicated their compatibility with the polymerase allosteric site. Critically, in vitro assays conducted on DENV infected cells confirmed the Proanthocyanidin exhibited potent dose-dependent antiviral activity with IC 50 values of 4.26-7.07 μM across DENV serotypes 1-4, with CC 50 >100 μM and selectivity indices > 14, indicating a favorable therapeutic window. These findings identify Proanthocyanidin as a promising RdRp-targeting antiviral candidate and demonstrate the value of integrating computational and experimental approaches for dengue drug discovery.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 分子瓶颈的使用为抗病毒干预提供了一种理想的方法,特别是当没有临床授权的抗病毒药物可用于对抗登革热时。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用了多层药物再利用方法,将计算筛选、高通量虚拟筛选 (HTVS)、标准精度 (SP) 和超精度 (XP) 与 SelleckChem FDA 批准并通过的 I 期药物库化合物与 DENV RdRp (PDB:5K5M) 进行分子对接,然后进行 200 ns 分子动力学 (MD) 模拟、自由结合能分析、自由能景观 (FEL) 分析和体外抗病毒验证。
elements_zh.methods: 重要的是,对 DENV 感染细胞进行的体外测定证实,原花青素表现出有效的剂量依赖性抗病毒活性,在 DENV 血清型 1-4 中,IC 50 值为 4.26-7.07 μM,CC 50 >100 μM,选择性指数 > 14,表明有利的治疗窗口。
elements_zh.main_results: 分子动力学模拟进一步证实了候选物的稳定性,该模拟基于与先导结构相比,RMSD 的最小变化和蛋白质的紧凑性,这共同表明了它们与聚合酶变构位点的相容性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些先导候选物与重要的催化和调节残基(包括 Arg 729 、Thr 794 、Ser 796 、Asp 664 和 Tyr 766 )建立了稳定的相互作用,表明它们具有破坏关键聚合酶活性的能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现将原花青素确定为一种有前途的 RdRp 靶向抗病毒候选药物,并证明了整合计算和实验方法用于登革热药物发现的价值。

papers.title_zh: 针对登革热病毒 RNA 依赖性 RNA 聚合酶的临床特征分子的精确再利用:计算机识别和体外验证
papers.source_body_en: The dengue virus has developed an effective replication mechanism that enables rapid viral replication in human hosts. The use of a molecular bottleneck offers an ideal approach for antiviral intervention, especially when no clinically authorized antivirals are available against dengue. The replication process is challenging due to functional redundancy. One of the core antiviral targets is the viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), a conserved and essential component of the DENV replication machinery with no mammalian homolog, which represents a promising target for antiviral intervention. This study employed a multi-tiered drug repurposing approach integrating computational screening, high-throughput virtual screening (HTVS), standard precision (SP), and extra precision (XP) molecular docking of SelleckChem FDA-approved & Passed Phase I Drug Library compounds against the DENV RdRp (PDB:5K5M), followed by 200 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, free binding energy analysis, free energy landscape (FEL) analysis, and in vitro antiviral validation. From the screening cascade, Proanthocyanidin and Stachyose were identified as lead candidates with Glide XP docking scores of -11.34 and - 13.08 kcal/mol and Molecular Mechanics/Generated Born Surface Area (MM-GBSA) binding free energies of -52.35 ± 5.29 kcal/mol, respectively. These lead candidates established stable interactions with important catalytic and regulatory residues, including Arg 729 , Thr 794 , Ser 796 , Asp 664 , and Tyr 766, indicating their ability to disrupt key polymerase activity. The stability of the candidates was further confirmed by Molecular dynamics simulations based on the minimal variations of RMSD and compactness of the protein compared with the lead structures, which collectively indicated their compatibility with the polymerase allosteric site. Critically, in vitro assays conducted on DENV infected cells confirmed the Proanthocyanidin exhibited potent dose-dependent antiviral activity with IC 50 values of 4.26-7.07 μM across DENV serotypes 1-4, with CC 50 >100 μM and selectivity indices > 14, indicating a favorable therapeutic window. These findings identify Proanthocyanidin as a promising RdRp-targeting antiviral candidate and demonstrate the value of integrating computational and experimental approaches for dengue drug discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热病毒已经发展出一种有效的复制机制,使得病毒能够在人类宿主中快速复制。分子瓶颈的使用为抗病毒干预提供了一种理想的方法,特别是当没有临床授权的抗病毒药物可用于对抗登革热时。由于功能冗余,复制过程具有挑战性。核心抗病毒靶点之一是病毒RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶(RdRp),它是DENV复制机制的保守且重要的组成部分,没有哺乳动物同源物,是抗病毒干预的一个有希望的靶点。本研究采用了多层药物再利用方法,将计算筛选、高通量虚拟筛选 (HTVS)、标准精度 (SP) 和超精度 (XP) 与 SelleckChem FDA 批准并通过的 I 期药物库化合物与 DENV RdRp (PDB:5K5M) 进行分子对接,然后进行 200 ns 分子动力学 (MD) 模拟、自由结合能分析、自由能景观 (FEL) 分析和体外抗病毒验证。从筛选级联中,原花青素和水苏糖被确定为主要候选物,其 Glide XP 对接分数分别为 -11.34 和 - 13.08 kcal/mol,分子力学/生成的出生表面积 (MM-GBSA) 结合自由能分别为 -52.35 ± 5.29 kcal/mol。这些先导候选物与重要的催化和调节残基(包括 Arg 729 、Thr 794 、Ser 796 、Asp 664 和 Tyr 766 )建立了稳定的相互作用,表明它们具有破坏关键聚合酶活性的能力。分子动力学模拟进一步证实了候选物的稳定性,该模拟基于与先导结构相比,RMSD 的最小变化和蛋白质的紧凑性,这共同表明了它们与聚合酶变构位点的相容性。重要的是,对 DENV 感染细胞进行的体外测定证实,原花青素表现出有效的剂量依赖性抗病毒活性,在 DENV 血清型 1-4 中,IC 50 值为 4.26-7.07 μM,CC 50 >100 μM,选择性指数 > 14,表明有利的治疗窗口。这些发现将原花青素确定为一种有前途的 RdRp 靶向抗病毒候选药物,并证明了整合计算和实验方法用于登革热药物发现的价值。

papers.title: Dengue Risk Mapping in Sri Lanka Using Spatial Interpolation, Machine Learning, and Ensemble Modeling
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue fever remains one of the most significant mosquito-borne public health challenges in Sri Lanka, with transmission patterns influenced by complex interactions between environmental conditions, population characteristics, and spatial variability. The ability to accurately identify areas with elevated dengue risk is essential for improving disease surveillance, resource allocation, and early intervention strategies. This study develops an integrated spatial and machine learning framework for district-level dengue risk mapping across Sri Lanka by combining Ordinary Kriging, Random Forest, Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), and ensemble modeling approaches. The study utilized dengue case data from 2019 to 2021 together with key environmental and socioeconomic variables, including rainfall, temperature, humidity, population density, and elevation. Data preprocessing, spatial preparation, and exploratory analysis were performed before applying predictive modeling techniques. Ordinary Kriging was implemented to capture spatial dependency and generate continuous dengue risk surfaces, while Random Forest and Multi-Layer Perceptron models were developed to identify complex nonlinear relationships between dengue occurrence and influencing factors. The Random Forest model demonstrated strong predictive capability by effectively capturing interactions among environmental and demographic variables, achieving an Area Under the Curve (AUC) value of 0.817. The model identified population density, temperature, elevation, and rainfall as important contributors to dengue risk variation. The MLP model further captured nonlinear patterns within the dataset, achieving an AUC value of 0.791. Ordinary Kriging successfully represented spatial continuity and revealed distinct geographic variations in dengue risk across Sri Lankan districts. To improve prediction stability, an ensemble framework was developed by integrating the outputs of the individual models. The combined approach provided a more balanced representation of dengue risk by utilizing the spatial strengths of Kriging and the predictive capabilities of machine learning models. The resulting risk maps highlighted consistently elevated risk patterns in highly populated districts, particularly Colombo, Gampaha, Kalutara, and several urbanized regions. The findings demonstrate that integrating geostatistical methods with machine learning provides a powerful approach for spatial disease risk assessment. The developed framework can support public health authorities, including district health offices and national dengue control programs, by providing evidence-based insights for targeted surveillance, resource allocation, and future early warning systems.

papers.title_zh: 使用空间插值、机器学习和集成建模绘制斯里兰卡登革热风险图
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Dengue fever remains one of the most significant mosquito-borne public health challenges in Sri Lanka, with transmission patterns influenced by complex interactions between environmental conditions, population characteristics, and spatial variability. The ability to accurately identify areas with elevated dengue risk is essential for improving disease surveillance, resource allocation, and early intervention strategies. This study develops an integrated spatial and machine learning framework for district-level dengue risk mapping across Sri Lanka by combining Ordinary Kriging, Random Forest, Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), and ensemble modeling approaches. The study utilized dengue case data from 2019 to 2021 together with key environmental and socioeconomic variables, including rainfall, temperature, humidity, population density, and elevation. Data preprocessing, spatial preparation, and exploratory analysis were performed before applying predictive modeling techniques. Ordinary Kriging was implemented to capture spatial dependency and generate continuous dengue risk surfaces, while Random Forest and Multi-Layer Perceptron models were developed to identify complex nonlinear relationships between dengue occurrence and influencing factors. The Random Forest model demonstrated strong predictive capability by effectively capturing interactions among environmental and demographic variables, achieving an Area Under the Curve (AUC) value of 0.817. The model identified population density, temperature, elevation, and rainfall as important contributors to dengue risk variation. The MLP model further captured nonlinear patterns within the dataset, achieving an AUC value of 0.791. Ordinary Kriging successfully represented spatial continuity and revealed distinct geographic variations in dengue risk across Sri Lankan districts. To improve prediction stability, an ensemble framework was developed by integrating the outputs of the individual models. The combined approach provided a more balanced representation of dengue risk by utilizing the spatial strengths of Kriging and the predictive capabilities of machine learning models. The resulting risk maps highlighted consistently elevated risk patterns in highly populated districts, particularly Colombo, Gampaha, Kalutara, and several urbanized regions. The findings demonstrate that integrating geostatistical methods with machine learning provides a powerful approach for spatial disease risk assessment. The developed framework can support public health authorities, including district health offices and national dengue control programs, by providing evidence-based insights for targeted surveillance, resource allocation, and future early warning systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热仍然是斯里兰卡最重大的蚊媒公共卫生挑战之一,其传播模式受到环境条件、人口特征和空间变异之间复杂相互作用的影响。准确识别登革热风险较高地区的能力对于改善疾病监测、资源分配和早期干预策略至关重要。本研究通过结合普通克里金法、随机森林、多层感知器 (MLP) 和集成建模方法,开发了一个集成的空间和机器学习框架,用于斯里兰卡地区级登革热风险测绘。该研究利用了 2019 年至 2021 年的登革热病例数据以及关键环境和社会经济变量,包括降雨量、温度、湿度、人口密度和海拔。在应用预测建模技术之前进行数据预处理、空间准备和探索性分析。实施普通克里金法来捕获空间依赖性并生成连续的登革热风险面,同时开发随机森林和多层感知器模型来识别登革热发生与影响因素之间的复杂非线性关系。随机森林模型通过有效捕捉环境和人口变量之间的相互作用表现出强大的预测能力,曲线下面积 (AUC) 值为 0.817。该模型将人口密度、温度、海拔和降雨量确定为登革热风险变化的重要影响因素。MLP 模型进一步捕获数据集中的非线性模式,实现 AUC 值 0.791。普通克里金法成功地代表了空间连续性,并揭示了斯里兰卡各地区登革热风险的明显地理差异。为了提高预测稳定性,通过集成各个模型的输出开发了一个集成框架。该组合方法利用克里金法的空间优势和机器学习模型的预测能力,提供了更平衡的登革热风险表示。由此产生的风险地图突出显示了人口稠密地区持续升高的风险模式,特别是科伦坡、加姆珀哈、卡卢特勒和几个城市化地区。研究结果表明,将地统计方法与机器学习相结合为空间疾病风险评估提供了一种强大的方法。开发的框架可以通过为有针对性的监测、资源分配和未来预警系统提供基于证据的见解,为包括地区卫生办公室和国家登革热控制计划在内的公共卫生当局提供支持。

papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengue fever poses a major public health challenge in India, with early prediction of severe complications—particularly dengue shock syndrome and severe hepatitis—remaining an unmet clinical need. Serum ferritin, an acute-phase reactant of macrophage activation, shows promise as a severity biomarker; however, serial kinetic data and novel ferritin-derived composite indices have not been systematically evaluated in adult Indian populations. This study aimed to characterise serial ferritin kinetics and to derive and evaluate the Ferritin-to-Platelet Ratio (FPR) and the Ferritin/ALT Ratio (FLR) as novel triage indices for dengue shock and severe hepatitis respectively. Methods A prospective observational study enrolled 100 adult dengue patients (WHO 2009 confirmed) at SMIMER, Surat, between June 2020 and November 2021. Serum ferritin was measured by sandwich ELISA on Days 1, 3, and 5 of hospitalisation. Severity was classified as non-severe (n = 72) or severe (n = 28). papers.title: Dengue virus-A neglected entity but causing global threat
papers.abstract: Aim: Dengue is a viral disease that is transmitted by the Aedes mosquito. It is found in tropical and subtropical regions of the world and is a major publichealth concern due to its high morbidity and mortality rates.Materials and Methods: The symptoms of dengue can range from mild to severe, and in some cases, it can be fatal. There is no specific treatment fordengue, but supportive care can help to alleviate symptoms and reduce the risk of complications. The virus that causes dengue is part of the Flavivirus genus,and there are four distinct serotypes. Once a person is infected with one serotype, they develop immunity to that particular serotype but remain susceptibleto the other three. Infection with a different serotype can increase the risk of severe dengue, which is also known as dengue hemorrhagic fever.Results: Various prevention measures for dengue include reducing the mosquito population through insecticide spraying, eliminating standing water wheremosquitoes breed, and using mosquito repellent. There is also a vaccine available for dengue, although it is not recommended for everyone and has limitedefficacy against all serotypes.Conclusion: Overall, dengue remains a significant public health issue, particularly in areas where the mosquito population is high and the healthcare systemis not well-equipped to handle severe cases. Ongoing efforts are needed to improve prevention.

papers.title_zh: 登革热病毒——一个被忽视但造成全球威胁的实体
papers.source_body_en: Aim: Dengue is a viral disease that is transmitted by the Aedes mosquito. It is found in tropical and subtropical regions of the world and is a major publichealth concern due to its high morbidity and mortality rates.Materials and Methods: The symptoms of dengue can range from mild to severe, and in some cases, it can be fatal. There is no specific treatment fordengue, but supportive care can help to alleviate symptoms and reduce the risk of complications. The virus that causes dengue is part of the Flavivirus genus,and there are four distinct serotypes. Once a person is infected with one serotype, they develop immunity to that particular serotype but remain susceptibleto the other three. Infection with a different serotype can increase the risk of severe dengue, which is also known as dengue hemorrhagic fever.Results: Various prevention measures for dengue include reducing the mosquito population through insecticide spraying, eliminating standing water wheremosquitoes breed, and using mosquito repellent. There is also a vaccine available for dengue, although it is not recommended for everyone and has limitedefficacy against all serotypes.Conclusion: Overall, dengue remains a significant public health issue, particularly in areas where the mosquito population is high and the healthcare systemis not well-equipped to handle severe cases. Ongoing efforts are needed to improve prevention.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:登革热是一种由伊蚊传播的病毒性疾病。它存在于世界热带和亚热带地区,由于其高发病率和死亡率而成为主要的公共卫生问题。材料和方法:登革热的症状可以从轻微到严重,在某些情况下可能是致命的。登革热没有具体的治疗方法,但支持治疗可以帮助缓解症状并降低并发症的风险。引起登革热的病毒属于黄病毒属,有四种不同的血清型。一旦一个人感染了一种血清型,他们就会对该特定血清型产生免疫力,但仍然容易受到其他三种血清型的影响。不同血清型的感染会增加严重登革热(也称为登革出血热)的风险。结果:登革热的各种预防措施包括通过喷洒杀虫剂减少蚊子数量、消除蚊子滋生的积水以及使用驱蚊剂。还有一种针对登革热的疫苗,但不建议所有人使用,而且对所有血清型的功效有限。结论:总体而言,登革热仍然是一个重大的公共卫生问题,特别是在蚊子数量较多且医疗系统没有足够能力处理严重病例的地区。需要不断努力改善预防。

papers.title: The Sigma1 ER membrane receptor promotes structural protein folding and genome packaging of dengue virus
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) exploits the host endoplasmic reticulum (ER) to support viral protein translation and folding, replication, and assembly, although the identity of ER factors that promote these distinct steps during infection remain unclear. Here we demonstrate that the ER-resident Sigma1 ER membrane receptor (S1R) promotes virus structural protein folding and genome packaging of DENV during infection. Under S1R knockdown (KD), DENV infection is impaired without compromising virus translation or replication. Strikingly, EM analysis revealed that DENV particles in and secreted from S1R-depleted cells are smaller, likely because they are empty particles devoid of the vRNA genome. Biochemical experiments demonstrated that S1R binds to the prM structural protein and under S1R KD, the prM, E and C structural proteins became detergent-insoluble. Thus, without S1R, all three virus structural proteins misfold, impairing efficient genome packaging. Together, these findings identify a novel ER chaperone that supports a critical DENV infection step.

papers.title: Detection of Dengue Virus in Aedes aegypti Mosquitoes, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
papers.abstract: We performed a 1-year mosquito survey in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, after a dengue virus outbreak in 2024. We collected 1,598 Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and detected dengue virus in 5 pools of < 20 mosquitoes. Our findings underscore the importance of sustained vector surveillance for dengue virus in arid urban environments.

papers.title: Deep learning with LSTM networks for dengue disease forecasting and control
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate forecasting of infectious disease dynamics is essential for effective public health planning and early outbreak response. Traditional statistical models and modern deep learning approaches have both been widely used for epidemiological time–series forecasting. Dengue fever remains a major public health concern in Bangladesh, where seasonal outbreaks often produce sharp and unpredictable infection spikes. Reliable forecasting models are therefore important for anticipating infection trends and supporting early intervention strategies. This study investigates the performance of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for predicting daily dengue infection counts in Bangladesh using surveillance data from 2010 to 2022. Multiple LSTM architectures were developed by varying the number of LSTM units, lookback window size, and data preprocessing strategies. A fixed time-based data split was used, with training data up to 30 September 2021 and testing on subsequent observations to avoid information leakage. The proposed LSTM models were compared with several baseline forecasting approaches, including Naive, Seasonal-Naive, and ARIMA models. Model performance was evaluated using standard forecasting metrics including Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE). Experimental results indicate that classical statistical models remain strong benchmarks for dengue forecasting. Among all evaluated models, the ARIMA(2,1,2) model achieved the best predictive performance on the test dataset with MAE of 8.40 and RMSE of 14.72. The best-performing LSTM configuration produced competitive results with MAE of 8.92 and RMSE of 15.87, outperforming simple baseline approaches such as the Naive and Seasonal-Naive models. These findings suggest that while deep learning models are capable of capturing complex temporal patterns, their advantage over well-tuned statistical models is not guaranteed for this dataset. The results highlight the importance of benchmarking deep learning models against classical time-series approaches when forecasting epidemiological data. While LSTM networks demonstrate promising performance in modeling nonlinear temporal dynamics, the ARIMA model provided the most accurate predictions for the studied dengue dataset.

Traditional statistical models and modern deep learning approaches have both been widely used for epidemiological time–series forecasting. Dengue fever remains a major public health concern in Bangladesh, where seasonal outbreaks often produce sharp and unpredictable infection spikes. Reliable forecasting models are therefore important for anticipating infection trends and supporting early intervention strategies. This study investigates the performance of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for predicting daily dengue infection counts in Bangladesh using surveillance data from 2010 to 2022. Multiple LSTM architectures were developed by varying the number of LSTM units, lookback window size, and data preprocessing strategies. A fixed time-based data split was used, with training data up to 30 September 2021 and testing on subsequent observations to avoid information leakage. The proposed LSTM models were compared with several baseline forecasting approaches, including Naive, Seasonal-Naive, and ARIMA models. Model performance was evaluated using standard forecasting metrics including Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE). Experimental results indicate that classical statistical models remain strong benchmarks for dengue forecasting. Among all evaluated models, the ARIMA(2,1,2) model achieved the best predictive performance on the test dataset with MAE of 8.40 and RMSE of 14.72. The best-performing LSTM configuration produced competitive results with MAE of 8.92 and RMSE of 15.87, outperforming simple baseline approaches such as the Naive and Seasonal-Naive models. These findings suggest that while deep learning models are capable of capturing complex temporal patterns, their advantage over well-tuned statistical models is not guaranteed for this dataset. The results highlight the importance of benchmarking deep learning models against classical time-series approaches when forecasting epidemiological data. While LSTM networks demonstrate promising performance in modeling nonlinear temporal dynamics, the ARIMA model provided the most accurate predictions for the studied dengue dataset.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 准确预测传染病动态对于有效的公共卫生规划和早期疫情应对至关重要。传统的统计模型和现代深度学习方法都被广泛用于流行病学时间序列预测。登革热仍然是孟加拉国的一个主要公共卫生问题,季节性疫情常常导致感染激增且难以预测。因此,可靠的预测模型对于预测感染趋势和支持早期干预策略非常重要。本研究利用 2010 年至 2022 年的监测数据,调查了长短期记忆 (LSTM) 网络在预测孟加拉国每日登革热感染计数方面的性能。通过改变 LSTM 单元的数量、回溯窗口大小和数据预处理策略,开发了多种 LSTM 架构。使用基于固定时间的数据分割,训练数据截至 2021 年 9 月 30 日,并对后续观察结果进行测试,以避免信息泄漏。将所提出的 LSTM 模型与几种基线预测方法进行了比较,包括 Naive、Seasonal-Naive 和 ARIMA 模型。使用标准预测指标评估模型性能,包括平均绝对误差 (MAE)、均方根误差 (RMSE) 和对称平均绝对百分比误差 (SMAPE)。实验结果表明,经典统计模型仍然是登革热预测的强有力基准。在所有评估的模型中,ARIMA(2,1,2)模型在测试数据集上取得了最好的预测性能,MAE为8.40,RMSE为14.72。性能最佳的 LSTM 配置产生了具有竞争力的结果,MAE 为 8.92,RMSE 为 15.87,优于朴素和季节朴素模型等简单基线方法。这些发现表明,虽然深度学习模型能够捕获复杂的时间模式,但对于该数据集,不能保证它们相对于经过良好调整的统计模型的优势。结果强调了在预测流行病学数据时将深度学习模型与经典时间序列方法进行基准测试的重要性。虽然 LSTM 网络在非线性时间动力学建模方面表现出良好的性能,但 ARIMA 模型为所研究的登革热数据集提供了最准确的预测。

papers.title: IgG and IgM Serological Profile in Primary and Secondary Dengue Infection
papers.abstract: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) remains a major health problem in endemic regions, requiring accurate laboratory examinations to support diagnosis. Serological testing of immunoglobulin G (IgG) and immunoglobulin M (IgM) is widely used to differentiate between primary and secondary dengue infections. This study aimed to analyze the serological profile of IgG and IgM as indicators of primary and secondary dengue infection in patients with DHF. A descriptive cross-sectional design was employed using secondary data from 170 patients who underwent IgG and IgM testing at RSUD Haji Surabaya. Data were analyzed descriptively by calculating frequency distributions and percentages. The results showed that the distribution was dominated by IgG positive and IgM negative findings (62%), followed by both IgG and IgM positive (17%), IgM positive only (10%), and both negative results (11%). These findings indicate that most patients experienced secondary dengue infection. Therefore, IgG and IgM serological testing plays an important role in determining the phase of dengue infection; however, it should be combined with other diagnostic methods to improve diagnostic accuracy.

papers.title: Dengue Fever Complicated by Acute Acalculous Cholecystitis and Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis Despite Negative PCR.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To report a case of dengue fever complicated by acute acalculous cholecystitis (AAC) and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), despite initial negative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) results. METHODS: We describe the clinical course of a 40-year-old woman who returned from Indonesia with a persistent fever and rash. The diagnosis was established through clinical evaluation, serological testing, and abdominal imaging. The study conformed to the principles outlined in the Declaration of Helsinki. RESULTS: Although the initial dengue PCR result was negative, subsequent NS1 and IgM antibody test results were positive. The patient developed severe complications, including AAC, characterized by gallbladder wall thickening, and HLH, indicated by marked fever, splenomegaly, hypofibrinogenemia, hyperferritinemia, and high soluble IL-2 receptor levels. Despite these symptoms, the patient was managed conservatively. Planned percutaneous transhepatic gallbladder aspiration was canceled because of spontaneous improvement observed on ultrasonography. The patient recovered fully without corticosteroid or platelet transfusions and was discharged on day 14. CONCLUSION: Given the potential for false-negative PCR results during the acute phase of dengue, multimodal serological testing is essential. This case demonstrates that severe atypical complications, such as AAC and HLH, can be resolved with supportive care alone, avoiding invasive procedures, immunosuppressive therapy, and platelet transfusion.

papers.title_zh: 尽管 PCR 呈阴性,但登革热仍并发急性非结石性胆囊炎和噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症。
papers.source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: To report a case of dengue fever complicated by acute acalculous cholecystitis (AAC) and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), despite initial negative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) results. METHODS: We describe the clinical course of a 40-year-old woman who returned from Indonesia with a persistent fever and rash. The diagnosis was established through clinical evaluation, serological testing, and abdominal imaging. The study conformed to the principles outlined in the Declaration of Helsinki. RESULTS: Although the initial dengue PCR result was negative, subsequent NS1 and IgM antibody test results were positive. The patient developed severe complications, including AAC, characterized by gallbladder wall thickening, and HLH, indicated by marked fever, splenomegaly, hypofibrinogenemia, hyperferritinemia, and high soluble IL-2 receptor levels. Despite these symptoms, the patient was managed conservatively. Planned percutaneous transhepatic gallbladder aspiration was canceled because of spontaneous improvement observed on ultrasonography. The patient recovered fully without corticosteroid or platelet transfusions and was discharged on day 14. CONCLUSION: Given the potential for false-negative PCR results during the acute phase of dengue, multimodal serological testing is essential. This case demonstrates that severe atypical complications, such as AAC and HLH, can be resolved with supportive care alone, avoiding invasive procedures, immunosuppressive therapy, and platelet transfusion.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:报告一例登革热并发急性非结石性胆囊炎(AAC)和噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症(HLH)的病例,尽管最初的聚合酶链反应(PCR)结果呈阴性。方法:我们描述了一名 40 岁女性的临床病程,她从印度尼西亚返回,出现持续发烧和皮疹。通过临床评估、血清学检测和腹部影像学检查确定诊断。该研究符合《赫尔辛基宣言》中概述的原则。结果:虽然最初的登革热PCR结果呈阴性,但随后的NS1和IgM抗体检测结果呈阳性。患者出现了严重的并发症,包括以胆囊壁增厚为特征的 AAC 和以明显发热、脾肿大、低纤维蛋白原血症、高铁蛋白血症和高可溶性 IL-2 受体水平为特征的 HLH。尽管有这些症状,患者仍接受保守治疗。由于超声检查观察到自发性改善,计划的经皮肝穿刺胆囊抽吸术被取消。患者在未输注皮质类固醇或血小板的情况下完全康复,并于第 14 天出院。结论:鉴于登革热急性期 PCR 结果可能出现假阴性,多模式血清学检测至关重要。该病例表明,严重的非典型并发症,如 AAC 和 HLH,可以仅通过支持性护理来解决,避免侵入性手术、免疫抑制治疗和血小板输注。

papers.title: A global assessment of dengue seasonality: Applying a novel, proportion-based method to case time series from 1990 to 2024
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue is a mosquito-borne, viral disease of increasing public health significance. Currently, most public health interventions target the vector, with efficacy dependent on timing within the season. Whilst seasonal profiles have been characterised in some endemic settings a global assessment is lacking. Here, we develop and apply a proportion-based measure of dengue seasonality to reported case time series from 1990 to 2024 across 106 countries and territories, the largest assessment of this phenomenon to date. We identify regional differences in seasonality such that every month of the year saw cases peak in at least one country or territory. Latitude was identified as influencing seasonality, with cases peaking between March and April in the southern hemisphere and July and October in the northern hemisphere. Equatorial locations displayed flat seasonality, and amplitude increased with distance from the equator. K-means clustering identified three seasonal profile types: two with pronounced seasonal outbreaks (with distinct peak timing and shape) and one with flatter, more endemic transmission. Peak month timing covaried among locations within the same seasonality cluster, with phase differences meaning that information on shifts in peak timing may be available several months in advance in some settings, of potential significance for prediction and intervention planning. Beyond aiding public health planning, identification of seasonal clusters suggests that information on dynamics in one location could be leveraged to improve forecasting power in others with similar seasonal dynamics. Author summary Understanding dengue seasonality is crucial for effective public health response. Most current interventions target the vector, with efficacy dependent on timing within the season. Previous work has shown that early implementation of interventions, targeting the vector when cases are increasing most rapidly rather than at their peak, leads to greater reduction of future incidence. Timing interventions in this way requires an understanding of the seasonal distribution of cases, and how consistent these patterns are between years. Despite this importance, seasonal profiles have only been characterised in a few endemic settings, leaving patterns in many at-risk locations poorly understood. Here we address this gap by developing and applying a new, proportion-based measure of dengue seasonality to case time series from 1990 to 2024 across 106 countries and territories. Measurements of peak timing and its variability bear immediate utility for decision making regarding intervention timing by public health agencies. We also define a new temporal window for considering dynamics, the “dengue season”, which adjusts for phase differences in annual time series. Clustering of seasons identifies three seasonal patterns. Observations of concordant peak shifts amongst locations within the same cluster identifies relationships with potential for outbreak early warning and improving forecasting power.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热是一种由蚊子传播的病毒性疾病,其公共卫生重要性日益凸显。目前,大多数公共卫生干预措施都针对媒介,其有效性取决于季节内的时间。虽然在一些地方病环境中已经描述了季节性特征,但缺乏全球评估。在此,我们开发了基于比例的登革热季节性衡量标准,并将其应用于 106 个国家和地区 1990 年至 2024 年报告的病例时间序列,这是迄今为止对这一现象的最大评估。我们确定了季节性的区域差异,一年中每个月至少有一个国家或地区出现病例高峰。纬度被认为影响季节性,南半球的病例高峰期为三月至四月,北半球的病例高峰为七月和十月。赤道位置表现出平坦的季节性,并且振幅随着距赤道距离的增加而增加。K 均值聚类确定了三种季节性特征类型:两种具有明显的季节性爆发(具有不同的高峰时间和形状),另一种具有更平坦、更具地方性的传播。同一季节性集群内不同地点之间的高峰月时间存在共变,存在相位差异,这意味着在某些情况下,有关高峰时间变化的信息可能会提前几个月获得,这对于预测和干预计划具有潜在意义。除了帮助公共卫生规划之外,季节性集群的识别表明,可以利用一个地点的动态信息来提高对具有类似季节性动态的其他地点的预测能力。作者摘要 了解登革热季节性对于有效的公共卫生应对措施至关重要。目前大多数干预措施都针对媒介,其有效性取决于季节内的时间。先前的研究表明,尽早实施干预措施,在病例增长最快而不是高峰时针对病媒,可以更大程度地减少未来的发病率。以这种方式进行时间干预需要了解病例的季节性分布,以及这些模式在年份之间的一致性。尽管如此重要,但季节性特征仅在少数地方病环境中得到表征,使得许多高危地区的模式知之甚少。在这里,我们通过开发一种新的、基于比例的登革热季节性衡量标准并将其应用于 1990 年至 2024 年 106 个国家和地区的病例时间序列来弥补这一差距。高峰时间及其变异性的测量对于公共卫生机构有关干预时间的决策具有直接效用。我们还定义了一个新的时间窗口来考虑动态,即“登革热季节”,它根据年度时间序列的相位差异进行调整。季节聚类确定了三种季节模式。对同一集群内不同位置之间一致的峰值变化的观察可以确定与爆发早期预警和提高预测能力的潜力之间的关系。

papers.title: Battling dengue in a warming world: How climate and urbanization shape transmission in low- and middle-income countries (a rapid review).
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a globally prevalent vector-borne disease, with low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) experiencing a disproportionate burden. Transmission patterns are increasingly influenced by rising global temperatures and rapid urbanization, yet no recent review has synthesized how these environmental factors are reshaping dengue dynamics in LMICs. METHODS: We conducted a rapid systematic review following a registered protocol (PROSPERO: CRD42025635982). Six databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Global Health, SciELO, Global Index Medicus and Web of Science) were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between January 2020 and November 2024. Studies were screened for climate or urbanization factors affecting dengue transmission in LMICs. Study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool for empirical studies and a structured assessment for modeling studies. Findings were synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Of the 65 included studies, 65% reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased dengue transmission, often attributed to intensified mosquito activity and longer transmission seasons. Urbanization was assessed in 35% of studies, with unplanned growth, informal settlements, and inadequate infrastructure frequently associated with increased risk. Several studies reported geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas, as well as seasonal shifts, including earlier onset and prolonged transmission periods. Urban heat islands and land-use change were commonly associated with localized transmission hotspots. Government responses were documented in 29% of studies, though many were hindered by fragmented surveillance systems, limited cross-sector coordination, or insufficient integration of climate data into public health planning. CONCLUSION: Climate change and urbanization are reshaping the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue in LMICs. Adaptive responses require strengthened surveillance and climate-informed planning in resilient urban infrastructure to reduce future transmission risks.
