papers.title_zh: 在变暖的世界中抗击登革热:气候和城市化如何影响低收入和中等收入国家的传播(快速回顾)。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a globally prevalent vector-borne disease, with low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) experiencing a disproportionate burden. Transmission patterns are increasingly influenced by rising global temperatures and rapid urbanization, yet no recent review has synthesized how these environmental factors are reshaping dengue dynamics in LMICs. METHODS: We conducted a rapid systematic review following a registered protocol (PROSPERO: CRD42025635982). Six databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Global Health, SciELO, Global Index Medicus and Web of Science) were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between January 2020 and November 2024. Studies were screened for climate or urbanization factors affecting dengue transmission in LMICs. Study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool for empirical studies and a structured assessment for modeling studies. Findings were synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Of the 65 included studies, 65% reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased dengue transmission, often attributed to intensified mosquito activity and longer transmission seasons. Urbanization was assessed in 35% of studies, with unplanned growth, informal settlements, and inadequate infrastructure frequently associated with increased risk. Several studies reported geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas, as well as seasonal shifts, including earlier onset and prolonged transmission periods. Urban heat islands and land-use change were commonly associated with localized transmission hotspots. Government responses were documented in 29% of studies, though many were hindered by fragmented surveillance systems, limited cross-sector coordination, or insufficient integration of climate data into public health planning. CONCLUSION: Climate change and urbanization are reshaping the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue in LMICs. Adaptive responses require strengthened surveillance and climate-informed planning in resilient urban infrastructure to reduce future transmission risks.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热是一种全球流行的媒介传播疾病,低收入和中等收入国家(LMIC)承受着不成比例的负担。传播模式越来越受到全球气温上升和快速城市化的影响,但最近没有综述综合这些环境因素如何重塑中低收入国家的登革热动态。方法:我们按照注册方案(PROSPERO:CRD42025635982)进行了快速系统评价。检索了六个数据库(MEDLINE、Embase、Global Health、SciELO、Global Index Medicus 和 Web of Science),查找 2020 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间发表的同行评审研究。研究筛选了影响中低收入国家登革热传播的气候或城市化因素。研究质量使用混合方法评估工具进行实证研究和结构化评估进行建模研究。调查结果以叙述方式综合。结果:在纳入的 65 项研究中,65% 报告称气温升高与登革热传播增加之间存在正相关关系,这通常归因于蚊子活动加剧和传播季节延长。35% 的研究对城市化进行了评估,无计划的增长、非正规住区和基础设施不足往往与风险增加相关。几项研究报告了向高地和城郊地区的地理扩张以及季节性变化,包括发病提前和传播周期延长。城市热岛和土地利用变化通常与局部传输热点有关。29% 的研究记录了政府的应对措施,尽管许多研究因监测系统分散、跨部门协调有限或气候数据未充分纳入公共卫生规划而受到阻碍。结论:气候变化和城市化正在重塑中低收入国家登革热的时空动态。适应性应对措施需要在有弹性的城市基础设施中加强监测和气候知情的规划,以减少未来的传播风险。

papers.title: [Clinical characteristics and outcomes of neonatal dengue fever in Foshan].
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To study the clinical characteristics, treatment, and outcomes of neonatal dengue fever in Foshan. METHODS: A retrospective study was conducted on 49 neonatal dengue fever cases collected from eight hospitals in Foshan between June and November 2024. Clinical characteristics and outcomes were evaluated. Cases were divided into an early-onset group (diagnosed ≤7 days of age; n=32) and a late-onset group (diagnosed 7 days of age; n=17) for comparison of clinical characteristics. RESULTS: Among the 49 neonates, fever was the predominant symptom (45 cases, 92%), followed by bleeding tendency (12 cases, 24%), tachypnea (11 cases, 22%), and jaundice (5 cases, 10%). The mothers of 30 neonates (61%) had perinatal dengue infection. Rates of maternal peripartum fever, confirmed maternal dengue fever during pregnancy, and perinatal dengue infection were significantly higher in the early-onset group than in the late-onset group (P0.05). The early-onset group had a longer hospital stay than the late-onset group (P0.05). Alanine aminotransferase levels were significantly higher in the late-onset group than in the early-onset group (P0.05). Symptomatic treatments, including short-term hemostatic therapy, nasal cannula oxygen supplementation, and noninvasive positive pressure ventilation when indicated, resulted in favorable outcomes without severe cases or deaths. CONCLUSIONS: Neonatal dengue fever in Foshan is associated with maternal perinatal dengue infection. Fever is the predominant clinical manifestation. Clinical characteristics differ by age at diagnosis, but overall prognosis is good. During dengue epidemic seasons, prevention and screening of perinatal dengue fever in pregnant women should be strengthened, and early laboratory tests such as pathogen detection and blood biochemistry should be performed on high-risk neonates.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:了解佛山市新生儿登革热的临床特征、治疗及转归。方法:对2024年6月至11月佛山市8家医院收治的49例新生儿登革热病例进行回顾性研究,评估其临床特征和转归。将病例分为早发组(诊断≤7天龄;n=32)和晚发组(诊断7天龄;n=17),比较临床特征。结果 49例新生儿中,以发热为主要症状(45例,92%),其次为出血倾向(12例,24%)、呼吸急促(11例,22%)、黄疸(5例,10%)。30 名新生儿(61%)的母亲患有围产期登革热感染。早发组孕产妇围产期发热、孕期确诊登革热、围生期登革热感染率均显着高于晚发组(P<0。05)。早发型组住院时间长于晚发型组(P<0。05)。晚发型组谷丙转氨酶水平显着高于早发型组(P<0。05)。对症治疗,包括短期止血治疗、鼻插管供氧和无创正压通气(有指征时),取得了良好的结果,没有出现严重病例或死亡。结论:佛山市新生儿登革热与孕产妇围产期登革热感染相关。发热是主要临床表现。临床特征因诊断年龄而异,但总体预后良好。登革热流行季节,应加强孕妇围产期登革热预防和筛查,对高危新生儿早期进行病原检测、血液生化等实验室检查。
papers.summary_zh: 目的:了解佛山市新生儿登革热的临床特征、治疗及转归。方法:对2024年6月至11月佛山市8家医院收治的49例新生儿登革热病例进行回顾性研究,评估其临床特征和转归。将病例分为早发组(诊断≤7天龄;n=32)和晚发组(诊断7天龄;n=17),比较临床特征。结果 49例新生儿中,以发热为主要症状(45例,92%),其次为出血倾向(12例,24%)、呼吸急促(11例,22%)、黄疸(5例,10%)。30 名新生儿(61%)的母亲患有围产期登革热感染。早发组孕产妇围产期发热、孕期确诊登革热、围生期登革热感染率均显着高于晚发组(P<0。05)。早发型组住院时间长于晚发型组(P<0。05)。晚发型组谷丙转氨酶水平显着高于早发型组(P<0。05)。对症治疗,包括短期止血治疗、鼻插管供氧和无创正压通气(有指征时),取得了良好的结果,没有出现严重病例或死亡。结论:佛山市新生儿登革热与孕产妇围产期登革热感染相关。发热是主要临床表现。临床特征因诊断年龄而异,但总体预后良好。登革热流行季节,应加强孕妇围产期登革热预防和筛查,对高危新生儿早期进行病原检测、血液生化等实验室检查。

papers.title: A smartphone-assisted paper-based colorimetric biosensor for rapid detection of dengue NS1 antigen.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus infection poses significant health risks, so rapid and early diagnosis is essential to mitigate these risks effectively. In this study, a paper-based NS1 biosensor was developed using surface-modified gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) bioconjugated with the NS1 monoclonal antibody (mAb) for colorimetric detection. The paper-based NS1 biosensor exhibits a color change upon interaction with the dengue NS1 antigen. Color signals were captured using a smartphone, and the images were analyzed in ImageJ to extract red, green, and blue (RGB) intensities for quantitative analysis. The paper-based NS1 biosensor exhibited a linear response for the detection of dengue NS1 antigen over the concentration range of 75 to 250 ng/mL, with a linear regression coefficient (R2) of 0.997, a limit of detection (LOD) of 10.95 ng/mL, and a detection time of 15 minutes. The paper-based NS1 biosensor demonstrated good selectivity, precision (RSD < 5%), and recovery from 93.40% to 98.54% in human serum samples. These findings indicate that the paper-based NS1 biosensor has potential as a simple, low-cost, portable, and potential as point-of-care device for early detection of the dengue virus.

papers.title: Post-infectious dengue cerebellitis in a patient with transfusion-dependent β-thalassaemia major: A case report
papers.abstract: Dengue fever is endemic in Sri Lanka and can rarely cause neurological complications, including post-infectious cerebellitis. Although patients with β-thalassaemia major have altered immune profiles, the intersection of expanded dengue syndrome with underlying haematological disorders is poorly documented. We report a 22-year-old woman with optimally managed, transfusion-dependent β-thalassaemia major who developed progressive cerebellar dysfunction eleven days after the onset of dengue haemorrhagic fever. papers.title_zh: 输血依赖性重型β地中海贫血患者感染后登革热小脑炎:病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Dengue fever is endemic in Sri Lanka and can rarely cause neurological complications, including post-infectious cerebellitis. Although patients with β-thalassaemia major have altered immune profiles, the intersection of expanded dengue syndrome with underlying haematological disorders is poorly documented. We report a 22-year-old woman with optimally managed, transfusion-dependent β-thalassaemia major who developed progressive cerebellar dysfunction eleven days after the onset of dengue haemorrhagic fever. Neurological examination revealed characteristic cerebellar signs, and the magnetic resonance imaging of the brain was normal. A clinical diagnosis of post-infectious dengue cerebellitis was made. Intravenous methylprednisolone led to rapid and complete resolution of symptoms.This case highlights a rare neurological sequela of dengue and underscores the need for vigilance for post-infectious autoimmune complications in multiply transfused patients, even when iron overload is minimal. We propose that chronic alloantigen exposure from lifelong transfusions establishes a constitutively dysregulated adaptive immune state, characterised by expanded Tregs and elevated IL-6, IL-10, and TGF-β, which may amplify post-viral autoimmune responses irrespective of iron overload status. This case emphasises the importance of early recognition and immunosuppressive treatment of immune-mediated neurological complications in optimally managed, multiply transfused patients.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热在斯里兰卡流行,很少会引起神经系统并发症,包括感染后小脑炎。尽管重型 β 地中海贫血患者的免疫特征发生了改变,但扩展的登革热综合征与潜在的血液系统疾病之间的交叉记录却很少。我们报告了一名 22 岁女性,患有经过最佳治疗的输血依赖性重型 β 地中海贫血,她在登革出血热发病 11 天后出现进行性小脑功能障碍。神经系统检查显示特征性小脑体征,大脑磁共振成像正常。临床诊断为感染后登革热小脑炎。静脉注射甲基强的松龙可快速、完全缓解症状。该病例凸显了登革热的罕见神经系统后遗症,并强调即使在铁超负荷很少的情况下,也需要对多次输血患者的感染后自身免疫并发症保持警惕。我们认为,终生输血导致的慢性同种异体抗原暴露会建立一种组成性失调的适应性免疫状态,其特征是Treg细胞扩增和IL-6、IL-10和TGF-β升高,这可能会放大病毒后自身免疫反应,无论铁超载状态如何。该病例强调了在最佳管理的多次输血患者中早期识别免疫介导的神经系统并发症并进行免疫抑制治疗的重要性。

papers.title: Bridging surveillance gaps in dengue: a hierarchical model integrating mixed data sources for transmission estimation and vaccine targeting
papers.abstract: Estimating dengue force of infection (FOI) is essential for understanding transmission dynamics and targeting intervention programmes, yet surveillance data in endemic settings required for estimations are often incomplete, with varying formats. We developed a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that jointly fits age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys within a single framework, incorporating external covariates to improve parameter identifiability. Synthetic validation showed that covariates alone recovered accurate FOI point estimates even when most districts contributed only aggregate data, but did so with poorly calibrated uncertainty; anchoring the model with a single seroprevalence survey was necessary to bring credible interval coverage close to nominal. Applied to 128 districts across Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016-2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in FOI and reporting rates. Many districts in Java exceeded the WHO-suggested seroprevalence threshold for vaccine introduction, yet were classified as low-priority when using reported incidence as prioritisation criterion, particularly in areas with weak surveillance. Model-based seroprevalence estimation, integrating multiple data sources, offers a more consistent basis for identifying high-priority districts for vaccine introduction, and is less susceptible to surveillance bias than reported incidence.

papers.title: Rural–Urban Variation in Dengue Vector Breeding Dynamics in Madurai District, Tamil Nadu, India: A Geo-Medical Study
papers.abstract: Dengue is one of the most important mosquito-borne viral diseases affecting tropical and subtropical regions worldwide. The principal dengue vectors, Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, exhibit considerable spatial and seasonal variation in their breeding ecology, particularly between rural and urban environments. This study investigated rural–urban variation in dengue vector breeding dynamics in Madurai District, Tamil Nadu, India, using a geo-medical approach. Primary field surveys were conducted in 705 randomly selected households across seven taluks during the dry and wet seasons. Larval and pupal samples were collected from different breeding containers, reared to adulthood, and identified at the ICMR–Vector Control Research Centre, Madurai. Adult mosquito abundance was assessed using the Adult Premise Index (API) and Female per Positive House (FPPH). Principal component analysis (PCA), hierarchical cluster analysis, and heat-map analysis were used to examine seasonal breeding patterns and spatial variation in vector distribution. The results indicated that Ae. aegypti predominated in urban areas, particularly during the dry season, when artificial containers such as tyres, barrels, cisterns, grinding stones, and earthen pots served as major breeding habitats. albopictus was more abundant during the wet season and was more frequently associated with rural and peri-urban environments. Several taluks recorded higher API and FPPH values, indicating spatial variation in adult mosquito density and potential dengue transmission risk. The findings showed that dengue vector ecology differed between rural and urban settings and varied across seasons. These results highlight the importance of location-specific surveillance, source reduction, and integrated vector management strategies for improving dengue prevention and control in Madurai District.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是热带地区主要的蚊媒病毒性疾病,主要媒介埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊在繁殖生态方面表现出空间和季节变化,特别是在农村和城市环境之间(A1、A2)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项地理医学研究调查了印度泰米尔纳德邦马杜赖地区登革热病媒繁殖动态的城乡差异,在旱季和雨季对七个塔鲁克岛的 705 个随机选择的家庭进行了初步实地调查(A3、A4)。
elements_zh.methods: 从繁殖容器中收集幼虫和蛹样本,饲养至成年,并在马杜赖 ICMR 病媒控制研究中心进行鉴定,同时使用成虫前提指数 (API) 和每阳性鸡舍雌性 (FPPH) 评估成蚊丰度 (A5、A6)。
elements_zh.main_results: 主成分分析 (PCA)、层次聚类分析和热图分析用于检查季节性繁殖模式和媒介分布的空间变化 (A7),结果表明登革热媒介生态在农村和城市环境之间存在差异,并且随季节变化 (A12)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 旱季期间,使用人工容器的城市地区埃及伊蚊占主导地位,而白纹伊蚊在雨季期间在农村和城市周边环境中更为丰富(A9、A10),这表明媒介生态学中存在新的空间和季节差异(A12)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果凸显了针对特定地点的监测、减少源头和综合病媒管理策略对于改善马杜赖区登革热预防和控制的重要性 (A13)。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告具体限制、偏倚、混杂因素、样本量合理性或对照,并且证据强度评估为中等(A3、A4、A7)。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 旱季期间,使用人工容器的城市地区埃及伊蚊占主导地位,而白纹伊蚊在雨季期间在农村和城市周边环境中更为丰富(A9、A10),这表明媒介生态学中存在新的空间和季节差异(A12)。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果凸显了针对特定地点的监测、减少源头和综合病媒管理策略对于改善马杜赖区登革热预防和控制的重要性 (A13)。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告具体限制、偏倚、混杂因素、样本量合理性或对照,并且证据强度评估为中等(A3、A4、A7)。

papers.title: EDUCAÇÃO EM SAÚDE COMO ESTRATÉGIA DE PREVENÇÃO E CONTROLE DA DENGUE NA COMUNIDADE
papers.abstract: A dengue constitui uma importante arbovirose de relevância epidemiológica, especialmente em países tropicais como o Brasil, onde fatores ambientais, socioeconômicos e falhas no saneamento favorecem a proliferação do mosquito Aedes aegypti. Diante do aumento expressivo de casos registrados em 2024, destaca-se a importância da Atenção Primária à Saúde na promoção de ações preventivas e educativas voltadas ao controle da doença. Este estudo trata-se de um relato de experiência desenvolvido a partir de uma ação de educação em saúde realizada no Centro de Saúde da Família Gerardo Carneiro Hardy, fundamentada na metodologia do Círculo de Cultura de Paulo Freire e nos princípios da Educação Popular. Participaram da atividade 26 moradores da comunidade, que foram envolvidos em uma roda de conversa sobre prevenção da dengue, identificação de sinais e sintomas, eliminação de criadouros e estratégias de combate ao vetor. Observou-se participação ativa dos usuários, compartilhamento de experiências e fortalecimento do vínculo entre comunidade e serviço de saúde. Conclui-se que metodologias participativas favorecem a construção coletiva do conhecimento, estimulam práticas preventivas e fortalecem a corresponsabilização social no enfrentamento da dengue, reforçando a necessidade de maior envolvimento multiprofissional nas ações educativas em saúde.
papers.journal: Caderno de ciências e saúde do semiárido

papers.title: Negative Binomial tv-DINGARCH Models for Monthly DHF Cases in Surabaya, Indonesia (2015-2025)
papers.abstract: Count time series data are commonly encountered in epidemiological studies, such as monthly reports of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) cases. The INGARCH model has been widely used to handle temporal dependence and overdispersion in such data. However, the standard INGARCH model assumes constant dispersion, whereas in practice the dispersion level may vary over time due to epidemiological factors like seasonality or vector control policies. Accurately capturing this time-varying variability is essential for reliable disease surveillance. This study applies the tv-DINGARCH model to DHF cases in Surabaya from January 2015 to December 2025. The tv-DINGARCH(1,1,1,1) model with Negative Binomial distribution is used because it allows the dispersion parameter \(\phi_t\) to evolve dynamically. Parameter estimation is conducted using the Conditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation method implemented in RStudio. The results show that the tv-DINGARCH model yields AIC = 968.43 and BIC = 985.68, both smaller than those of the standard INGARCH model (AIC = 1012.18, BIC = 1023.68). The likelihood ratio test produces an LR statistic of 47.7560 with a p-value less than 0.000001, strongly rejecting constant dispersion. The stationarity condition is satisfied with \(\beta_2 + \alpha_2 + \beta_1 + \alpha_1 = 0.9990 1\). From a public health perspective, these findings indicate that the tv-DINGARCH model better captures the fluctuating dynamics of DHF transmission, supporting more effective surveillance and early warning systems.

source_records.title: Negative Binomial tv-DINGARCH Models for Monthly DHF Cases in Surabaya, Indonesia (2015-2025)
source_records.abstract: Count time series data are commonly encountered in epidemiological studies, such as monthly reports of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) cases. The INGARCH model has been widely used to handle temporal dependence and overdispersion in such data. However, the standard INGARCH model assumes constant dispersion, whereas in practice the dispersion level may vary over time due to epidemiological factors like seasonality or vector control policies. Accurately capturing this time-varying variability is essential for reliable disease surveillance. This study applies the tv-DINGARCH model to DHF cases in Surabaya from January 2015 to December 2025. The tv-DINGARCH(1,1,1,1) model with Negative Binomial distribution is used because it allows the dispersion parameter \(\phi_t\) to evolve dynamically. Parameter estimation is conducted using the Conditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation method implemented in RStudio. The results show that the tv-DINGARCH model yields AIC = 968.43 and BIC = 985.68, both smaller than those of the standard INGARCH model (AIC = 1012.18, BIC = 1023.68). The likelihood ratio test produces an LR statistic of 47.7560 with a p-value less than 0.000001, strongly rejecting constant dispersion. The stationarity condition is satisfied with \(\beta_2 + \alpha_2 + \beta_1 + \alpha_1 = 0.9990 1\). From a public health perspective, these findings indicate that the tv-DINGARCH model better captures the fluctuating dynamics of DHF transmission, supporting more effective surveillance and early warning systems.

Accurately capturing this time-varying variability is essential for reliable disease surveillance. This study applies the tv-DINGARCH model to DHF cases in Surabaya from January 2015 to December 2025. The tv-DINGARCH(1,1,1,1) model with Negative Binomial distribution is used because it allows the dispersion parameter \(\phi_t\) to evolve dynamically. The results show that the tv-DINGARCH model yields AIC = 968.43 and BIC = 985.68, both smaller than those of the standard INGARCH model (AIC = 1012.18, BIC = 1023.68). papers.abstract_zh: 流行病学研究中经常会遇到计数时间序列数据,例如登革出血热 (DHF) 病例的月度报告。INGARCH 模型已广泛用于处理此类数据中的时间依赖性和过度分散。然而,标准 INGARCH 模型假设离散程度恒定,而实际上,由于季节性或病媒控制政策等流行病学因素,离散程度可能随时间变化。准确捕捉这种随时间变化的变异性对于可靠的疾病监测至关重要。本研究将 tv-DINGARCH 模型应用于泗水 2015 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月的 DHF 病例。使用负二项分布的 tv-DINGARCH(1,1,1,1) 模型是因为它允许离散参数 \(\phi_t\) 动态演化。参数估计是使用 RStudio 中实现的条件最大似然估计方法进行的。结果表明,tv-DINGARCH 模型的 AIC = 968.43 和 BIC = 985.68,均小于标准 INGARCH 模型的结果(AIC = 1012.18,BIC = 1023.68)。似然比检验产生 LR 统计量为 47.7560,p 值小于 0.000001,强烈拒绝恒定离散。平稳性条件满足 \(\beta_2 + \alpha_2 + \beta_1 + \alpha_1 = 0.9990 1\)。从公共卫生角度来看,这些发现表明 tv-DINGARCH 模型更好地捕捉 DHF 传播的波动动态,支持更有效的监测和预警系统。

papers.title: Structure-based Free Energy Evaluation of Papaya Flavonoids as Dengue Virus NS5 RdRp Inhibitors via Molecular Simulations, Steered Molecular Dynamics, and Umbrella Sampling
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) NS5’s RdRp domain is a conserved and functionally necessary enzyme, making it an interesting antiviral target. This study examined Carica papaya flavonoids’ efficacy in inhibiting DENV-RdRp’s allosteric binding domain utilizing structure-based in silico methods. Eight flavonoids were evaluated for RdRp enzyme binding affinity using molecular dynamics simulations, principal component analysis, and free energy landscapes. The molecular simulation studies predicted the formation of stable protein–ligand complex structures in a biological system. Further protein–ligand structure dissociation and unbinding energetics were quantified using SMD simulations with umbrella sampling. By deriving free energy profiles, all eight RdRp-flavonoid complexes showed thermodynamic feasibility for protein–ligand binding with neohesperidin, manghaslin, and isoquercetin complexes having binding energies of −17.35 kcal⋅mol[Formula: see text], −16.52 kcal⋅mol[Formula: see text], and −16.04 kcal⋅mol[Formula: see text], respectively. These results were aligned with the MD and post-MD MMGBSA binding free energy calculations. Thus, we successfully identified and analyzed papaya flavonoid-based natural scaffolds that target DENV-RdRp using advanced molecular simulation methods.
papers.journal: Journal of Computational Biophysics and Chemistry

papers.title: Mechanism and spectrum of inhibition of viral polymerases by 2′-deoxy-2′-β-fluoro-4′-azidocytidine or azvudine
papers.abstract: The therapeutic value of antiviral nucleoside analogs was highlighted during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, with remdesivir and molnupiravir repurposed for their broad-spectrum antiviral activity. The cytidine analog azvudine (FNC) has recently gained attention as a potential treatment for human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection. Considering the distinct substrate specificities of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase (RT) and SARS-CoV-2 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), a unifying mechanism of inhibition remains elusive. Here, we assessed the inhibitory effects of FNC’s active triphosphate form, FNC-TP, across several viral polymerases. The relative efficiency of FNC-TP incorporation followed the order: HIV-1 RT > hepatitis C virus (HCV) RdRp > respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) RdRp > dengue virus type 2 (DENV-2) RdRp ≫ SARS-CoV-2 RdRp. Its incorporation caused chain-termination in all polymerases tested. Antiviral activity against HIV-1 has previously been demonstrated and is here shown with DENV-2. Collectively, the data show that inhibition of viral polymerases by FNC-TP can translate to antiviral activity against both retroviruses and RNA viruses, but the link is not evident for SARS-CoV-2. FNC-TP is a poor substrate for SARS-CoV-2 RdRp, and FNC lacks significant antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2 in cell culture.

papers.title: IMPLEMENTASI KEBIJAKAN PENANGGULANGAN DEMAM BERDARAH DENGUE (DBD) DI DESA KARANGNANAS KECAMATAN SOKARAJA
papers.abstract: Implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) merupakan upaya penting dalam menekan tingginya angka kasus DBD di Indonesia. Desa Karangnanas, Kecamatan Sokaraja, Kabupaten Banyumas tercatat sebagai desa dengan jumlah kasus DBD tertinggi di Kecamatan Sokaraja pada tahun 2024. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan DBD di Desa Karangnanas. Penelitian menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan deskriptif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Informan penelitian terdiri atas pemerintah desa, petugas puskesmas, kader kesehatan, dan masyarakat yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan DBD di Desa Karangnanas secara umum telah berjalan cukup baik ditinjau dari aspek komunikasi, sumber daya, disposisi, dan struktur birokrasi menurut teori George C. Komunikasi dilakukan melalui penyuluhan kesehatan, kegiatan Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN), serta koordinasi antar pelaksana. Sumber daya didukung oleh tenaga kesehatan, kader, fasilitas, dan anggaran, meskipun masih terdapat keterbatasan sarana dan partisipasi masyarakat. Disposisi pelaksana dilaksanakan melalui komitmen dan tanggung jawab dalam pelaksanaan program, sedangkan struktur birokrasi didukung oleh prosedur operasional standar dan pembagian tugas yang jelas. Faktor pendukung implementasi meliputi koordinasi lintas sektor, dukungan pemerintah desa, keterlibatan kader kesehatan, dan media edukasi masyarakat. Faktor penghambat tersebut meliputi rendahnya partisipasi sebagian masyarakat, luasnya wilayah pengawasan, keterbatasan tenaga pelaksana, serta tingginya beban kerja kader kesehatan. Kata kunci: Implementasi Kebijakan, Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD), Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN), Partisipasi Masyarakat
papers.journal: GOVERNANCE Jurnal Ilmiah Kajian Politik Lokal dan Pembangunan

papers.title_zh: 实施登革热 (DBD) DI DESA KARANGNANAS KECAMATAN SOKARAJA
papers.source_body_en: Implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) merupakan upaya penting dalam menekan tingginya angka kasus DBD di Indonesia. Desa Karangnanas, Kecamatan Sokaraja, Kabupaten Banyumas tercatat sebagai desa dengan jumlah kasus DBD tertinggi di Kecamatan Sokaraja pada tahun 2024. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan DBD di Desa Karangnanas. Penelitian menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan deskriptif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Informan penelitian terdiri atas pemerintah desa, petugas puskesmas, kader kesehatan, dan masyarakat yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan DBD di Desa Karangnanas secara umum telah berjalan cukup baik ditinjau dari aspek komunikasi, sumber daya, disposisi, dan struktur birokrasi menurut teori George C. Komunikasi dilakukan melalui penyuluhan kesehatan, kegiatan Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN), serta koordinasi antar pelaksana. Sumber daya didukung oleh tenaga kesehatan, kader, fasilitas, dan anggaran, meskipun masih terdapat keterbatasan sarana dan partisipasi masyarakat. Disposisi pelaksana dilaksanakan melalui komitmen dan tanggung jawab dalam pelaksanaan program, sedangkan struktur birokrasi didukung oleh prosedur operasional standar dan pembagian tugas yang jelas. Faktor pendukung implementasi meliputi koordinasi lintas sektor, dukungan pemerintah desa, keterlibatan kader kesehatan, dan media edukasi masyarakat. Faktor penghambat tersebut meliputi rendahnya partisipasi sebagian masyarakat, luasnya wilayah pengawasan, keterbatasan tenaga pelaksana, serta tingginya beban kerja kader kesehatan. papers.title: Climate Variability and Dengue Dynamics: A Path Analysis in Surabaya, Indonesia
papers.abstract: Introduction: Dengue fever is a climate-sensitive vector-borne disease. While many studies have documented associations between climate variables and dengue incidence, most rely on conventional regression approaches that fail to separate direct and indirect climatic pathways, limiting mechanistic understanding and utility for environmental health. This study aims to elucidate the interconnected effects of climatic variability on dengue incidence in Surabaya. This study integrates seasonal time-series decomposition and path analysis to distinguish direct and indirect climatic pathways, sunlight duration and wind speed. Methods: A retrospective ecological design, monthly dengue incidence data from 2020 to 2024 were integrated with meteorological variables, including rainfall, temperature, humidity, sunlight duration, and wind speed. Seasonal time-series decomposition was applied to characterize temporal dynamics, followed by path analysis within a structural equation modeling framework to quantify direct and indirect climatic effects. Results and Discussion: A pronounced seasonal pattern in dengue incidence, with peaks during the rainy season. Maximum temperature, relative humidity, sunlight duration, and minimum wind speed exerted significant direct effects on dengue incidence (p < 0.05). Rainfall showed no direct association but acted as a key upstream driver influencing other climatic variables. The structural model explained 52.1% of the variance in dengue incidence, highlighting the contribution of interconnected climatic processes. Conclusion: These findings demonstrate that dengue dynamics in tropical metropolitan environments are governed by complex climate-mediated pathways rather than isolated climatic predictors. This study novel environmental epidemiological evidence to support climate-informed dengue early warning systems and adaptive vector control strategies under climate variability and urban environmental change.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是一种对气候敏感的媒介传播疾病,虽然与气候变量的关联已被记录,但传统的回归方法无法区分直接和间接的气候路径,限制了对环境健康的机制理解和效用。本研究旨在阐明气候变化对泗水登革热发病率的相互影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用回顾性生态设计,将 2020 年至 2024 年每月登革热发病率数据与印度尼西亚泗水的降雨量、温度、湿度、日照时长和风速等气象变量相结合。
elements_zh.methods: 应用季节时间序列分解来表征时间动态,然后在结构方程模型框架内进行路径分析,以量化气候对登革热发病率的直接和间接影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 最高温度、相对湿度、日照持续时间和最小风速对登革热发病率产生显着的直接影响(p < 0.05),而降雨量没有显示出直接关联,而是影响其他气候变量的关键上游驱动因素。结构模型解释了登革热发病率差异的 52.1%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,热带大都市环境中的登革热动态是由复杂的气候介导途径控制的,而不是孤立的气候预测因素。这项研究提供了新的环境流行病学证据,以支持气候知情的登革热早期预警系统和适应性病媒控制策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要整合多种气候变量的综合监测系统,以更准确地预测城市热带环境中的登革热疫情。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到其生态设计的限制,无法进行因果推断,并且可能会受到无法测量的混杂因素的影响。由于依赖回顾性数据和单一城市环境,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:登革热是一种对气候敏感的媒介传播疾病。虽然许多研究已经记录了气候变量与登革热发病率之间的关联,但大多数研究都依赖于传统的回归方法,这些方法无法区分直接和间接的气候路径,限制了对环境健康的机制理解和效用。本研究旨在阐明气候变化对泗水登革热发病率的相互影响。这项研究整合了季节时间序列分解和路径分析,以区分直接和间接的气候路径、日照时长和风速。方法:采用回顾性生态设计,将2020年至2024年每月登革热发病数据与降雨量、温度、湿度、日照时长和风速等气象变量相结合。应用季节时间序列分解来表征时间动态,然后在结构方程模型框架内进行路径分析,以量化直接和间接的气候影响。结果和讨论:登革热发病具有明显的季节性模式,在雨季达到高峰。最高温度、相对湿度、日照时间和最小风速对登革热发病率产生显着的直接影响(p < 0.05)。降雨量没有显示出直接关联,但却是影响其他气候变量的关键上游驱动因素。该结构模型解释了登革热发病率差异的 52.1%,强调了相互关联的气候过程的贡献。结论:这些发现表明,热带大都市环境中的登革热动态受复杂的气候介导途径而非孤立的气候预测因子的控制。这项研究提供了新的环境流行病学证据,以支持气候变化和城市环境变化下的气候信息登革热早期预警系统和适应性病媒控制策略。

papers.title: Integrated surveillance of arboviruses in febrile patients from the Brazilian Amazon reveals complex co-circulation dynamics and hidden viral diversity
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Arboviral infections continue to be a significant public health challenge in the Brazilian Amazon. Overlapping symptoms, limited laboratory access, and the circulation of multiple arboviruses hamper clinical diagnosis. This study aimed to characterize the epidemiological, clinical, laboratory and genomic profiles of arboviral infections in febrile patients in Manaus, Brazil, and explore additional viral agents using metagenomic sequencing. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted between February 2021 and February 2023 at a tertiary reference center in Manaus, Brazil. Patients aged ≥ 5 years of age presenting with a rash and either a fever or a history of fever lasting <7 days and a negative thick blood smear for malaria were enrolled. Serum samples were tested for dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), yellow fever virus (YF), Oropouche virus (OROV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) using ELISA and RT-qPCR. Positive samples were subjected to amplicon-based genome sequencing for phylogenetic analysis. A subset of RT-qPCR negative samples was analyzed using de novo shotgun metagenomic sequencing. Results: Among the 708 enrolled participants, 243 (34.3%) had a laboratory-confirmed arboviral infection: 92 (37.9%) DENV, 64 (26.3%) CHIKV, and 4 (1.6%) ZIKV, while 83 (34.2%) laboratory profiles were compatible with coinfection, predominantly DENV+CHIKV (55/83; 66.3%). Circulation of DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III (Asian American) and II (Cosmopolitan) was identified. Metagenomic analysis of 35 samples detected Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate complex arbovirus co-circulation in Manaus and support integrated surveillance strategies combining molecular, serological, and genomic approaches.
papers.journal: Revista da Sociedade Brasileira de Medicina Tropical

analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted from February 2021 to February 2023 at a tertiary reference center in Manaus, Brazil. Patients aged 5 years or older with rash and either fever or a history of fever lasting less than 7 days, and a negative thick blood smear for malaria, were enrolled.
analysis.methods: Serum samples were tested for dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), yellow fever virus (YF), Oropouche virus (OROV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) using ELISA and RT-qPCR. analysis.main_results: Among 708 participants, 243 (34.3%) had laboratory-confirmed arboviral infections: 92 (37.9%) DENV, 64 (26.3%) CHIKV, and 4 (1.6%) ZIKV. Metagenomic analysis of 35 samples detected Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrates complex co-circulation of arboviruses in Manaus and highlights the utility of integrated surveillance combining molecular, serological, and genomic approaches. Novel detection of Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1 expands the known viral diversity in febrile patients.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings underscore the need for integrated diagnostic strategies to improve arbovirus surveillance and patient management in endemic regions. analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and single-center setting, which may restrict generalizability. Reliance on RT-qPCR and ELISA for primary detection introduces potential false negatives, and metagenomic sequencing was applied to a small subset of samples, limiting broader conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study in Manaus, Brazil, enrolled 708 febrile patients with rash to characterize arboviral infections between 2021 and 2023. Using ELISA, RT-qPCR, and metagenomic sequencing, 34.3% of participants tested positive for arboviruses, with dengue (37.9%), chikungunya (26.3%), and Zika (1.6%) predominating. Coinfections were common (34.2%), primarily DENV+CHIKV (66.3%). Phylogenetic analysis identified DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III and II. Metagenomics revealed Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1 in 35 samples. The authors conclude that integrated surveillance combining molecular, serological, and genomic methods is essential to address complex arbovirus co-circulation and hidden viral diversity in endemic settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于重叠的临床表现、有限的诊断能力以及多种病毒的共同传播,虫媒病毒感染对巴西亚马逊地区造成了持续的公共卫生负担。该研究解决了巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染特征的需要,该地区的诊断挑战阻碍了准确识别。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。年龄为 5 岁或以上、有皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续不到 7 天、疟疾厚血涂片呈阴性的患者被纳入研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的登革热病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和马亚罗病毒 (MAYV)。阳性样本进行了基于扩增子的基因组测序以进行系统发育分析,而 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集则使用从头鸟枪法宏基因组测序进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 708 名参与者中,243 名(34.3%)人患有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染:92 名(37.9%)DENV、64 名(26.3%)CHIKV 和 4 名(1.6%)ZIKV。在 83 例 (34.2%) 病例中检测到混合感染,主要是 DENV+CHIKV (55/83;66.3%)。鉴定出 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(国际大都会)。对 35 个样本的宏基因组分析检测到人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究证明了马瑙斯虫媒病毒的复杂共循环,并强调了结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合监测的实用性。对人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1 型的新检测扩大了发热患者中已知的病毒多样性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调需要采取综合诊断策略来改善虫媒病毒流行地区的监测和患者管理。其他病毒因子的检测表明发热性疾病中非虫媒病毒病原体的诊断可能存在不足。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计和单中心设置的限制,这可能会限制普遍性。依赖 RT-qPCR 和 ELISA 进行初步检测会带来潜在的假阴性,而且宏基因组测序仅应用于一小部分样本,限制了更广泛的结论。

Conclusions: These findings demonstrate complex arbovirus co-circulation in Manaus and support integrated surveillance strategies combining molecular, serological, and genomic approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景:虫媒病毒感染仍然是巴西亚马逊地区的一个重大公共卫生挑战。重叠的症状、有限的实验室访问以及多种虫媒病毒的传播阻碍了临床诊断。本研究旨在描述巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染的流行病学、临床、实验室和基因组特征,并利用宏基因组测序探索其他病毒因子。方法:2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。年龄≥5岁、出现皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续<7天且疟疾厚血涂片呈阴性的患者被纳入研究。使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的登革热病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和马亚罗病毒 (MAYV)。对阳性样本进行基于扩增子的基因组测序以进行系统发育分析。使用从头鸟枪宏基因组测序分析 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集。结果:在 708 名入组参与者中,243 名(34.3%)有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染:92 名(37.9%)DENV、64 名(26.3%)CHIKV 和 4 名(1.6%)ZIKV,而 83 名(34.2%)实验室资料符合双重感染,主要是 DENV+CHIKV(55/83;66.3%)。确定了 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(国际大都会)的循环。对 35 个样本的宏基因组分析检测到人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1. 结论:这些发现表明马瑙斯存在复杂的虫媒病毒共循环,并支持结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合监测策略。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于重叠的临床表现、有限的诊断能力以及多种病毒的共同传播,虫媒病毒感染对巴西亚马逊地区造成了持续的公共卫生负担。该研究解决了巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染特征的需要,该地区的诊断挑战阻碍了准确识别。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。年龄为 5 岁或以上、有皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续不到 7 天、疟疾厚血涂片呈阴性的患者被纳入研究。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的登革热病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和马亚罗病毒 (MAYV)。阳性样本进行了基于扩增子的基因组测序以进行系统发育分析,而 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集则使用从头鸟枪法宏基因组测序进行分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 708 名参与者中,243 名(34.3%)人患有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染:92 名(37.9%)DENV、64 名(26.3%)CHIKV 和 4 名(1.6%)ZIKV。在 83 例 (34.2%) 病例中检测到混合感染,主要是 DENV+CHIKV (55/83;66.3%)。鉴定出 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(国际大都会)。对 35 个样本的宏基因组分析检测到人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究证明了马瑙斯虫媒病毒的复杂共循环,并强调了结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合监测的实用性。对人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1 型的新检测扩大了发热患者中已知的病毒多样性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调需要采取综合诊断策略来改善虫媒病毒流行地区的监测和患者管理。其他病毒因子的检测表明发热性疾病中非虫媒病毒病原体的诊断可能存在不足。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计和单中心设置的限制,这可能会限制普遍性。依赖 RT-qPCR 和 ELISA 进行初步检测会带来潜在的假阴性,而且宏基因组测序仅应用于一小部分样本,限制了更广泛的结论。

papers.title: Enfermedades transmitidas por vectores: chagas, dengue, malaria y hantavirus
papers.abstract: Rol estratégico de la Atención Primaria: el personal médico de familia es fundamental para el cribado inicial, el manejo ambulatorio de los casos leves y la prevención del colapso hospitalario. Alta sospecha clínica: el diagnóstico inicial se fundamenta en vincular un síndrome febril inespecífico con un nexo epidemiológico claro (viajes recientes, picaduras o exposición a roedores/brotes cerrados). Identificación de «banderas rojas»: es prioritario reconocer los signos de alarma (como sangrado de mucosas, dolor abdominal intenso, compromiso respiratorio o descompensación cardíaca) para garantizar una derivación hospitalaria inmediata y oportuna. Acción comunitaria: la educación para el control del vector y la notificación epidemiológica son pilares indelegables en el abordaje integral desde el centro de salud.

papers.title: Rural dengue dynamics: the interplay of climate, built environment, and agriculture in Costa Rica
papers.abstract: Dengue is one of the worlds highest-burden arboviral diseases. Although classically considered an urban disease, many regions experience a substantial dengue burden in rural areas. The combined influence of long-term climate, short-term weather variation, local built environments, and land-use gradients on dengue dynamics in rural settings remains poorly understood, limiting our ability to predict shifting risk under global change. Here, we investigate these dynamics in Costa Rica to disentangle how these interacting socio-environmental factors shape rural dengue transmission. We first use 22 years of canton-level (admin-2) case data to establish that both dengue cases and incidence are consistently higher in rural than in urban districts. Then, using ten years of district-level (admin-3) monthly case data and a Bayesian hierarchical modeling framework, we identify the climatic and land-use features most strongly associated with dengue risk. Temperature underlies broad spatial patterns in dengues urban-rural distribution, while precipitation effects differ between coasts, reflecting intercoastal climate zone contrasts rather than interactions between urbanization and water availability. Given suitable climate, even modest levels of built infrastructure substantially increase risk, but the relationship plateaus at higher levels of building volume. Dengue risk is also elevated in areas with high agricultural crop cover at low and mid elevations but not at higher, cooler elevations. Together these results suggest that high risk of rural dengue in Costa Rica result from climate suitability aligning with baseline levels of built infrastructure, with agriculture potentially emerging as a distinct driver of rural dengue transmission.

papers.title_zh: 农村登革热动态:哥斯达黎加气候、建筑环境和农业的相互作用
papers.source_body_en: Dengue is one of the worlds highest-burden arboviral diseases. Although classically considered an urban disease, many regions experience a substantial dengue burden in rural areas. The combined influence of long-term climate, short-term weather variation, local built environments, and land-use gradients on dengue dynamics in rural settings remains poorly understood, limiting our ability to predict shifting risk under global change. Here, we investigate these dynamics in Costa Rica to disentangle how these interacting socio-environmental factors shape rural dengue transmission. We first use 22 years of canton-level (admin-2) case data to establish that both dengue cases and incidence are consistently higher in rural than in urban districts. Then, using ten years of district-level (admin-3) monthly case data and a Bayesian hierarchical modeling framework, we identify the climatic and land-use features most strongly associated with dengue risk. Temperature underlies broad spatial patterns in dengues urban-rural distribution, while precipitation effects differ between coasts, reflecting intercoastal climate zone contrasts rather than interactions between urbanization and water availability. Given suitable climate, even modest levels of built infrastructure substantially increase risk, but the relationship plateaus at higher levels of building volume. Dengue risk is also elevated in areas with high agricultural crop cover at low and mid elevations but not at higher, cooler elevations. Together these results suggest that high risk of rural dengue in Costa Rica result from climate suitability aligning with baseline levels of built infrastructure, with agriculture potentially emerging as a distinct driver of rural dengue transmission.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热是世界上负担最重的虫媒病毒疾病之一。尽管通常被认为是一种城市疾病,但许多地区的农村地区都面临着巨大的登革热负担。长期气候、短期天气变化、当地建筑环境和土地利用梯度对农村地区登革热动态的综合影响仍知之甚少,限制了我们预测全球变化下风险转移的能力。在这里,我们调查了哥斯达黎加的这些动态,以阐明这些相互作用的社会环境因素如何影响农村登革热传播。我们首先使用 22 年的州级 (admin-2) 病例数据来确定农村地区的登革热病例和发病率始终高于城市地区。然后,利用十年来的区级 (admin-3) 每月病例数据和贝叶斯分层建模框架,我们确定了与登革热风险最密切相关的气候和土地利用特征。温度是登革热城乡分布的广泛空间模式的基础,而沿海之间的降水影响不同,反映了沿海气候区的对比,而不是城市化和水资源可用性之间的相互作用。在适宜的气候条件下,即使是适度的基础设施建设也会显着增加风险,但这种关系在建筑量较高的情况下会趋于稳定。在低海拔和中海拔农作物覆盖率较高的地区,登革热风险也较高,但在较高、较冷的海拔地区则不然。这些结果共同表明,哥斯达黎加农村登革热的高风险是由于气候适宜性与已建基础设施的基线水平一致造成的,而农业可能成为农村登革热传播的独特驱动因素。

papers.title: Climate change and the growing threat of bunyaviruses
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Anthropogenic climate change and its implications for infectious diseases have been central to the scientific and public health discourse for more than three decades. In 2026, we have now entered a climate adaptation phase, with accumulating evidence demonstrating that ongoing climatic variability is directly reshaping the dynamics of multiple vector-borne viruses, including bunyaviruses. Bunyaviruses comprise a diverse group of segmented, negative-sense RNA viruses that include significant human and veterinary pathogens, such as Rift Valley fever virus, Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus, Oropouche virus, and Cache Valley fever virus. Despite their medical and veterinary importance, climate-virus relationships remain comparatively less well characterized for bunyaviruses than for viruses such as dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever. This gap is increasingly notable in light of recent epidemiological shifts, exemplified by the 2022–2025 expansion of Oropouche virus across the Americas and the Caribbean, which highlights how bunyaviruses can exploit ecological disruption and underscores the need to better understand the environmental determinants of their transmission. Advances in genomic surveillance, experimental virology, and climate-informed epidemiology now enable these interconnected virus-host-vector-environment dynamics to be examined with increasing precision. In this minireview, we synthesize current evidence linking environmental change to bunyavirus transmission and geographic expansion, identify critical mechanistic and surveillance gaps, and outline priorities for developing predictive frameworks to strengthen bunyavirus preparedness within a One Health context.

papers.title_zh: 气候变化和布尼亚病毒日益严重的威胁
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Anthropogenic climate change and its implications for infectious diseases have been central to the scientific and public health discourse for more than three decades. In 2026, we have now entered a climate adaptation phase, with accumulating evidence demonstrating that ongoing climatic variability is directly reshaping the dynamics of multiple vector-borne viruses, including bunyaviruses. Bunyaviruses comprise a diverse group of segmented, negative-sense RNA viruses that include significant human and veterinary pathogens, such as Rift Valley fever virus, Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus, Oropouche virus, and Cache Valley fever virus. Despite their medical and veterinary importance, climate-virus relationships remain comparatively less well characterized for bunyaviruses than for viruses such as dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever. This gap is increasingly notable in light of recent epidemiological shifts, exemplified by the 2022–2025 expansion of Oropouche virus across the Americas and the Caribbean, which highlights how bunyaviruses can exploit ecological disruption and underscores the need to better understand the environmental determinants of their transmission. Advances in genomic surveillance, experimental virology, and climate-informed epidemiology now enable these interconnected virus-host-vector-environment dynamics to be examined with increasing precision. In this minireview, we synthesize current evidence linking environmental change to bunyavirus transmission and geographic expansion, identify critical mechanistic and surveillance gaps, and outline priorities for developing predictive frameworks to strengthen bunyavirus preparedness within a One Health context.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 三十多年来,人为气候变化及其对传染病的影响一直是科学和公共卫生讨论的核心。2026 年,我们现已进入气候适应阶段,越来越多的证据表明,持续的气候变化正在直接重塑包括布尼亚病毒在内的多种媒介传播病毒的动态。布尼亚病毒由多种分段、负义 RNA 病毒组成,其中包括重要的人类和兽医病原体,例如裂谷热病毒、克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒、奥罗普切病毒和卡什谷热病毒。尽管布尼亚病毒在医学和兽医学上具有重要意义,但与登革热、寨卡病毒、基孔肯雅热和黄热病等病毒相比,气候与病毒之间的关系仍然不太清楚。鉴于最近的流行病学变化,这一差距日益显着,例如 2022 年至 2025 年奥罗普切病毒在美洲和加勒比地区的扩张,这凸显了布尼亚病毒如何利用生态破坏,并强调需要更好地了解其传播的环境决定因素。基因组监测、实验病毒学和气候流行病学的进步现在使这些相互关联的病毒-宿主-载体-环境动态能够得到越来越精确的检查。在这篇小型综述中,我们综合了将环境变化与布尼亚病毒传播和地理扩张联系起来的现有证据,确定了关键的机制和监测差距,并概述了开发预测框架的优先事项,以在“同一个健康”背景下加强布尼亚病毒的防范。

papers.title: Exploration of viral diversity in Aedes mosquitoes employing different shotgun metagenomic data analysis pipelines.
papers.abstract: Metagenomics or metaviromics is emerging as a powerful technology for pathogen surveillance and pandemic preparedness. Mosquitoes are important vectors for transmission of many emerging viruses responsible for numerous outbreaks. Monitoring mosquitoes becomes essential to investigate its virome which leads to understanding of disease dynamics and allow preventive actions. In this study, shotgun metagenomic methodology using Ion GeneStudio S5 System was optimized for exploration of viral diversity. A total of 1913 Aedes larvae were collected from Central India during post monsoon season of 2024. Aedes larvae reared to adulthood and processed for sequencing using Ion Torrent S5 platform. Computational analyses were performed using three bioinformatic pipelines: Chan Zuckerberg ID (CZ ID), Genome Detective Platform and the Galaxy Platform. A mock database of 11 known viruses was created as well as publicly available NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) datasets were used to validate all three pipelines. In terms of detection accuracy, Genome Detective and CZ ID performed exceptionally well and therefore may be suitable for future mosquito virome surveillance studies. We found presence of viruses viz. Alphamesonivirus cavallynense and Phasivirus phasiense dominating in all samples. Dengue virus was detected in one sample by CZ ID, whereas Wenzhou sobemo-like virus, Hubei mosquito virus 2, Cell fusing agent virus found most commonly among samples. Other viruses found like Aedes anphevirus (AeAV; genus Glybovirus), Aedes totivirus, Verdadero virus and Chaq-like virus. Variation in the result among different pipelines are likely attributable to incorporation of different viral reference databases, classification algorithms, metrics and analysis parameters. To the best of our knowledge, this study represents the first metagenomic study of mosquitoes using Ion GeneStudio S5 platform in India. The findings provide a comparative evaluation of the metagenomic pipelines and elucidates detailed information of each pipeline and its working for future studies.

papers.title_zh: 使用不同的鸟枪宏基因组数据分析流程探索伊蚊的病毒多样性。
papers.source_body_en: Metagenomics or metaviromics is emerging as a powerful technology for pathogen surveillance and pandemic preparedness. Mosquitoes are important vectors for transmission of many emerging viruses responsible for numerous outbreaks. Monitoring mosquitoes becomes essential to investigate its virome which leads to understanding of disease dynamics and allow preventive actions. In this study, shotgun metagenomic methodology using Ion GeneStudio S5 System was optimized for exploration of viral diversity. A total of 1913 Aedes larvae were collected from Central India during post monsoon season of 2024. Aedes larvae reared to adulthood and processed for sequencing using Ion Torrent S5 platform. Computational analyses were performed using three bioinformatic pipelines: Chan Zuckerberg ID (CZ ID), Genome Detective Platform and the Galaxy Platform. A mock database of 11 known viruses was created as well as publicly available NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) datasets were used to validate all three pipelines. In terms of detection accuracy, Genome Detective and CZ ID performed exceptionally well and therefore may be suitable for future mosquito virome surveillance studies. We found presence of viruses viz. Alphamesonivirus cavallynense and Phasivirus phasiense dominating in all samples. Dengue virus was detected in one sample by CZ ID, whereas Wenzhou sobemo-like virus, Hubei mosquito virus 2, Cell fusing agent virus found most commonly among samples. Other viruses found like Aedes anphevirus (AeAV; genus Glybovirus), Aedes totivirus, Verdadero virus and Chaq-like virus. Variation in the result among different pipelines are likely attributable to incorporation of different viral reference databases, classification algorithms, metrics and analysis parameters. To the best of our knowledge, this study represents the first metagenomic study of mosquitoes using Ion GeneStudio S5 platform in India. The findings provide a comparative evaluation of the metagenomic pipelines and elucidates detailed information of each pipeline and its working for future studies.

papers.title: The Resurgence of Oropouche Virus: A Review on Evolution, Epidemiology, Pathophysiology, Vaccine Development and Global Health Preparedness
papers.abstract: The Oropouche virus (OROV) is an emerging arbovirus grouped under Orthobunyavirus genus of Peribunyaviridae family, first identified in Trinidad and Tobago in 1955, and re-emerged as a serious public health concern in the Central and South Americas. Recently, numbers of OROV cases are on the rise with the 2024 outbreak documenting over 12,000 cases across endemic and newly affected regions, including first-time detections in Caribbean nations and imported cases in the United States, Canada, and Italy. The OROV has caused over 5,00,000 cases globally, with substantial underreporting owing to clinical similarities with Zika, chikungunya and dengue. The virus is mainly transmitted by midges viz. Culicoides paraensis (Goeldi), though alternative vectors such as Culex quinquefasciatus Say and Aedes serratus (Theobald) have also been identified. Clinical manifestations range from acute febrile illness with biphasic fever in approximately 60% of cases to severe complications including haemorrhagic symptoms along with neurological sequelae such as meningitis, encephalitis, and Guillain-Barre syndrome. The virus exhibits complex transmission cycles (urban and sylvatic) and reassortment-driven evolution. The evidence of vertical transmission has emerged, with documented cases of fetal microcephaly, stillbirths, and congenital malformations. Pathogenesis involves modulation of host innate immunity, particularly interferon responses. The virus demonstrates neuroinvasive potential through blood-brain barrier penetration and has been shown to persist in various tissues. Diagnostic challenges arise from non-specific clinical signs and limited access to specialized laboratory tests. At present, no specific treatment or vaccines against the OROV are available and management limited to supportive care. However, promising vaccine candidates such as live-attenuated, inactivated, and recombinant protein-based platforms are undergoing preclinical and clinical evaluation, offering hope for future preventive strategies against this neglected tropical disease.

papers.title_zh: 奥罗普切病毒的死灰复燃:进化、流行病学、病理生理学、疫苗开发和全球卫生准备的回顾
papers.source_body_en: The Oropouche virus (OROV) is an emerging arbovirus grouped under Orthobunyavirus genus of Peribunyaviridae family, first identified in Trinidad and Tobago in 1955, and re-emerged as a serious public health concern in the Central and South Americas. Recently, numbers of OROV cases are on the rise with the 2024 outbreak documenting over 12,000 cases across endemic and newly affected regions, including first-time detections in Caribbean nations and imported cases in the United States, Canada, and Italy. The OROV has caused over 5,00,000 cases globally, with substantial underreporting owing to clinical similarities with Zika, chikungunya and dengue. The virus is mainly transmitted by midges viz. Culicoides paraensis (Goeldi), though alternative vectors such as Culex quinquefasciatus Say and Aedes serratus (Theobald) have also been identified. Clinical manifestations range from acute febrile illness with biphasic fever in approximately 60% of cases to severe complications including haemorrhagic symptoms along with neurological sequelae such as meningitis, encephalitis, and Guillain-Barre syndrome. The virus exhibits complex transmission cycles (urban and sylvatic) and reassortment-driven evolution. The evidence of vertical transmission has emerged, with documented cases of fetal microcephaly, stillbirths, and congenital malformations. Pathogenesis involves modulation of host innate immunity, particularly interferon responses. The virus demonstrates neuroinvasive potential through blood-brain barrier penetration and has been shown to persist in various tissues. Diagnostic challenges arise from non-specific clinical signs and limited access to specialized laboratory tests. At present, no specific treatment or vaccines against the OROV are available and management limited to supportive care. However, promising vaccine candidates such as live-attenuated, inactivated, and recombinant protein-based platforms are undergoing preclinical and clinical evaluation, offering hope for future preventive strategies against this neglected tropical disease.
papers.abstract_zh: 奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 是一种新兴的虫媒病毒,属于周布尼亚病毒科正布尼亚病毒属,于 1955 年首次在特立尼达和多巴哥发现,并在中美洲和南美洲重新成为严重的公共卫生问题。最近,随着 2024 年疫情爆发,OROV 病例数量不断增加,在流行地区和新受影响地区记录了超过 12,000 例病例,其中包括加勒比国家的首次发现病例以及美国、加拿大和意大利的输入病例。OROV 已在全球造成超过 500,000 例病例,由于与寨卡、基孔肯雅热和登革热的临床相似性,大量漏报病例。该病毒主要通过蠓传播。帕拉库蠓 (Goeldi),但也已鉴定出其他媒介,如库蚊 (Culex quinquefasciatus Say) 和锯缘伊蚊 (Theobald)。临床表现包括约 60% 的病例出现双相发热的急性发热性疾病,以及严重并发症,包括出血症状以及脑膜炎、脑炎和格林巴利综合征等神经系统后遗症。该病毒表现出复杂的传播周期(城市和森林)和重配驱动的进化。垂直传播的证据已经出现,有记录的胎儿小头畸形、死产和先天畸形的病例。发病机制涉及宿主先天免疫的调节,特别是干扰素反应。该病毒通过血脑屏障渗透表现出神经侵袭潜力,并已被证明可以在多种组织中持续存在。诊断挑战源于非特异性临床体征和专业实验室检测的有限性。目前,尚无针对 OROV 的具体治疗方法或疫苗,治疗仅限于支持性护理。然而,有前途的候选疫苗,如减毒活疫苗、灭活疫苗和基于重组蛋白的平台正在接受临床前和临床评估,为未来针对这种被忽视的热带疾病的预防策略带来希望。

papers.title: Insecticide resistance in mosquitoes: Current status, mechanism, monitoring and innovative strategies for sustainable vector control
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne diseases such as malaria, dengue, chikungunya, Zika and yellow fever remain major public health challenges worldwide, causing millions of cases and thousands of deaths annually. Vector control has been the cornerstone of prevention strategies, with insecticides being the most commonly used intervention. However, the widespread and often indiscriminate use of insecticides has led to the emergence of insecticide resistance in the mosquito population, thereby threatening the sustainability of existing control measures. This review presents the current status of insecticide resistance, its underlying mechanisms, and global trends in resistance. The alternative vector control strategies, such as genetic modification, Wolbachia-based methods, botanical insecticides and nanotechnology-driven control measures, are also highlighted. It also explores the significance of insecticide resistance monitoring, integrated resistance management strategies and the need for new compounds with a distinct mode of action to ensure the continued effectiveness of vector control.

papers.abstract_zh: 疟疾、登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒和黄热病等蚊媒疾病仍然是全世界主要的公共卫生挑战,每年造成数百万例病例和数千人死亡。病媒控制一直是预防策略的基石,其中杀虫剂是最常用的干预措施。然而,杀虫剂的广泛且往往不加区别的使用导致蚊子种群出现杀虫剂抗药性,从而威胁到现有控制措施的可持续性。本综述介绍了杀虫剂耐药性的现状、其潜在机制以及全球耐药性趋势。还强调了替代病媒控制策略,例如基因改造、基于沃尔巴克氏体的方法、植物杀虫剂和纳米技术驱动的控制措施。它还探讨了杀虫剂抗性监测、综合抗性管理策略的重要性,以及对具有独特作用模式的新化合物的需求,以确保病媒控制的持续有效性。

papers.title: House modifications using insecticide-treated screening of eave and window as a vector control tool: evidence from a semi-field system in Tanzania and simulated epidemiological impact.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Gaps in unimproved house structures, especially in eaves and windows, allow mosquito entry, increasing indoor vector-borne disease transmission. Simple modifications to such houses may reduce human exposure, and insecticide treatment may kill mosquitoes, benefiting all community members. This study evaluated insecticide-treated screening (ITS) for eaves and windows, incorporated with deltamethrin and piperonyl butoxide (PBO), compared to a permethrin and PBO-treated bednet in Tanzania. METHOD: A randomised Latin-square design (4 × 4) was used in four experimental huts within a large netting cage to allow mosquito recapture inside and outside of huts. Four treatments were evaluated: (1) new (12-month stored) ITS; (2) 12-month naturally-aged ITS; (3) 12-month field-used pyrethroid-PBO bednet (standard of care in Tanzania), and (4) no treatment. The study was performed for 32 nights using 30 mosquitoes per strain, per hut per night. Four laboratory-reared strains were used: malaria vectors (Anopheles arabiensis and An. funestus), dengue vector (Aedes aegypti), and nuisance biting (Culex quinquefasciatus). Recaptured mosquitoes were assessed for mortality at 72 h, blood-feeding, and hut entry. A simulation with a modified mechanistic model tracking Plasmodium falciparum malaria was used to illustrate potential epidemiological impact from these products. RESULTS: Against all mosquito species compared to 12-month aged pyrethroid-PBO-treated bednet, new ITS induced higher mortality [Odds Ratio:2.25(95%Confidence Interval:1.65-3.06),p < 0.0001], and aged-ITS was similar [OR:0.80(95%CI:0.59-1.08),p = 0.141]. Both new and aged ITS significantly (p < 0.0001) reduced mosquito blood-feeding [new OR:0.02(95% CI:0.01-0.03); aged OR:0.09(95%CI:0.05-0.14)] and hut entry [new IRR:0.10(95%CI:0.08-0.13); aged IRR:0.25(95%CI:0.21-0.31)]. Transmission model estimates indicate epidemiological impacts of ITS may supersede pyrethroid-PBO-treated bednets at the population level. The model results indicate impact potency depends on assumed intervention percentage cover, durability, and mosquito bionomics. CONCLUSIONS: This study introduces a standardised semi-field bioassay to evaluate ITS, generating entomological data that, for the first time, enabled modelling of its potential impact on malaria transmission. ITS is an efficacious tool for public health as it kills substantial proportions of malaria and dengue vectors, and reduces nuisance biting. Given its simplicity, it should be considered an additional or stand-alone tool for screening unimproved houses.

papers.title_zh: 使用经杀虫剂处理的屋檐和窗户屏蔽作为病媒控制工具进行房屋改造:来自坦桑尼亚半田系统的证据和模拟流行病学影响。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Gaps in unimproved house structures, especially in eaves and windows, allow mosquito entry, increasing indoor vector-borne disease transmission. Simple modifications to such houses may reduce human exposure, and insecticide treatment may kill mosquitoes, benefiting all community members. This study evaluated insecticide-treated screening (ITS) for eaves and windows, incorporated with deltamethrin and piperonyl butoxide (PBO), compared to a permethrin and PBO-treated bednet in Tanzania. METHOD: A randomised Latin-square design (4 × 4) was used in four experimental huts within a large netting cage to allow mosquito recapture inside and outside of huts. Four treatments were evaluated: (1) new (12-month stored) ITS; (2) 12-month naturally-aged ITS; (3) 12-month field-used pyrethroid-PBO bednet (standard of care in Tanzania), and (4) no treatment. The study was performed for 32 nights using 30 mosquitoes per strain, per hut per night. Four laboratory-reared strains were used: malaria vectors (Anopheles arabiensis and An. funestus), dengue vector (Aedes aegypti), and nuisance biting (Culex quinquefasciatus). Recaptured mosquitoes were assessed for mortality at 72 h, blood-feeding, and hut entry. A simulation with a modified mechanistic model tracking Plasmodium falciparum malaria was used to illustrate potential epidemiological impact from these products. RESULTS: Against all mosquito species compared to 12-month aged pyrethroid-PBO-treated bednet, new ITS induced higher mortality [Odds Ratio:2.25(95%Confidence Interval:1.65-3.06),p < 0.0001], and aged-ITS was similar [OR:0.80(95%CI:0.59-1.08),p = 0.141]. Both new and aged ITS significantly (p < 0.0001) reduced mosquito blood-feeding [new OR:0.02(95% CI:0.01-0.03); aged OR:0.09(95%CI:0.05-0.14)] and hut entry [new IRR:0.10(95%CI:0.08-0.13); aged IRR:0.25(95%CI:0.21-0.31)]. Transmission model estimates indicate epidemiological impacts of ITS may supersede pyrethroid-PBO-treated bednets at the population level. The model results indicate impact potency depends on assumed intervention percentage cover, durability, and mosquito bionomics. CONCLUSIONS: This study introduces a standardised semi-field bioassay to evaluate ITS, generating entomological data that, for the first time, enabled modelling of its potential impact on malaria transmission. ITS is an efficacious tool for public health as it kills substantial proportions of malaria and dengue vectors, and reduces nuisance biting. Given its simplicity, it should be considered an additional or stand-alone tool for screening unimproved houses.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:未改进的房屋结构中的缝隙,尤其是屋檐和窗户,容易让蚊子进入,增加室内媒介传播疾病的传播。对此类房屋进行简单改造可以减少人类接触,杀虫剂处理可以杀死蚊子,使所有社区成员受益。本研究评估了经杀虫剂处理的屋檐和窗户纱网 (ITS),并与坦桑尼亚经氯菊酯和 PBO 处理的蚊帐进行了比较,并与溴氰菊酯和胡椒基丁醚 (PBO) 进行了比较。方法:在大型网笼内的四个实验小屋​​中采用随机拉丁方设计(4 × 4),以便在小屋内外重新捕获蚊子。评估了四种处理方法:(1)新的(保存 12 个月的)ITS;(2) 12个月自然老化的ITS;(3) 12 个月现场使用的拟除虫菊酯-PBO 蚊帐(坦桑尼亚的标准护理),以及 (4) 不进行治疗。该研究进行了 32 个晚上,每间小屋每晚使用 30 只蚊子。使用四种实验室饲养的菌株:疟疾媒介(阿拉伯按蚊和按蚊)、登革热媒介(埃及伊蚊)和令人讨厌的叮咬媒介(致倦库蚊)。对重新捕获的蚊子进行 72 小时死亡率、吸血情况和进入小屋的评估。使用修改后的机制模型进行模拟,跟踪恶性疟原虫疟疾,以说明这些产品的潜在流行病学影响。结果:与 12 个月老化的拟除虫菊酯-PBO 处理的蚊帐相比,针对所有蚊种,新 ITS 导致更高的死亡率 [比值比:2.25(95% 置信区间:1.65-3.06),p < 0.0001],而老化 ITS 相似 [OR:0.80(95% CI:0.59-1.08),p = 0.141]。新旧 ITS 均显着 (p < 0.0001) 减少蚊子吸血 [新 OR:0.02(95% CI:0.01-0.03);旧OR:0.09(95%CI:0.05-0.14)]和小屋入口[新IRR:0.10(95%CI:0.08-0.13);老化IRR:0.25(95%CI:0.21-0.31)]。传播模型估计表明,ITS 的流行病学影响可能会在人口层面取代经拟除虫菊酯-PBO 处理的蚊帐。模型结果表明影响效力取决于假设的干预覆盖率、持久性和蚊子生物学特性。结论:本研究引入了标准化半场生物测定来评估 ITS,生成昆虫学数据,首次能够对其对疟疾传播的潜在影响进行建模。ITS 是公共卫生的有效工具,因为它可以杀死大量疟疾和登革热媒介,并减少令人讨厌的叮咬。鉴于其简单性,应将其视为筛选未改良房屋的附加或独立工具。

papers.title: Habitat Type and Seasonal Variation as Drivers of Mosquito Proliferation in Urban Aquatic Microhabitats
papers.abstract: Abstract Aedes aegypti is the primary vector species for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya viruses, and is adapted to thrive in urban environments. Their proximity to human populations and the adverse health outcomes associated with arboviral infections make mosquito control essential for reducing the risk of outbreaks and disease spread. Source reduction and larvicide applications are central components of mosquito control because they reduce adult mosquito emergence by targeting immature life stages. Therefore, our objective was to identify urban aquatic habitats used by Ae. aegypti and assess temporal variation in their contribution to immature mosquito production. To distinguish habitat use from habitat productivity, we considered larval presence as an indicator of oviposition or early-stage survival and pupal presence as evidence that a habitat supported development through most of the immature life cycle. Between July 2018 and October 2019, 2,482 inspections in Miami-Dade County, Florida, identified 2,756 aquatic habitats from which 19,466 Ae. aegypti larvae and 3,648 pupae were collected. Unique temporal trends were observed for both larval and pupal presence and abundance at county and habitat resolutions. County-level trends showed the highest larval and pupal production during Summer and the lowest pupal production during Winter. However, temporal patterns differed across habitats, supporting a context-dependent interpretation of habitat conduciveness, in which the same habitat type may support different levels of immature mosquito production depending on local environmental conditions. Our results show that habitats with frequent larval occurrence did not consistently have high pupal presence, indicating that larval presence does not necessarily reflect habitat productivity. Control strategies that prioritize habitats repeatedly associated with pupal production by season may improve year-round mosquito control, outbreak preparedness, and resource allocation.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 埃及伊蚊是登革热、寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅病毒的主要媒介物种,适合在城市环境中繁衍生息。由于蚊子与人群的距离很近,并且与虫媒病毒感染相关的不良健康后果,因此控制蚊子对于降低疫情和疾病传播的风险至关重要。减少源头和杀幼虫剂的应用是蚊子控制的核心组成部分,因为它们通过针对未成熟的生命阶段来减少成蚊的出现。因此,我们的目标是确定伊蚊使用的城市水生栖息地。埃及伊蚊并评估其对未成熟蚊子生产的贡献的时间变化。为了区分栖息地利用和栖息地生产力,我们将幼虫的存在视为产卵或早期生存的指标,将蛹的存在视为栖息地在大部分未成熟生命周期中支持发育的证据。2018 年 7 月至 2019 年 10 月期间,佛罗里达州迈阿密戴德县进行了 2,482 次检查,发现了 2,756 个水生栖息地,其中 19,466 种白斑蚊。收集了埃及伊蚊幼虫和 3,648 只蛹。在县和栖息地分辨率下,观察到幼虫和蛹的存在和丰度的独特时间趋势。县级趋势显示,夏季幼虫和蛹产量最高,冬季蛹产量最低。然而,不同栖息地的时间模式不同,支持对栖息地有利性的上下文相关解释,其中相同的栖息地类型可能根据当地环境条件支持不同水平的未成熟蚊子生产。我们的结果表明,幼虫频繁出现的栖息地并不总是有大量的蛹存在,这表明幼虫的存在并不一定反映栖息地的生产力。按季节优先考虑与蛹生产相关的栖息地的控制策略可能会改善全年的蚊子控制、疫情爆发准备和资源分配。

papers.title: Editorial: Integrated genomic and systems approaches to unravel host-virus interactions in viral infectious diseases
papers.abstract: Two contributions examine viruses targeting the central nervous system (CNS). A clinical and proteomic analysis of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from 69 patients with varicella-zoster virus (VZV) CNS infection documents the predominant manifestations of headache, fever, and motor/sensory disturbances. CSF proteomics revealed markedly elevated protein abundance relative to controls, with upregulated proteins enriched in IFN-1 signaling, pyroptosis, and blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption pathways. Complement system overactivation in severe encephalitis cases emerged as a candidate marker of disease severity and a potential therapeutic target, underscoring the value of CSF proteomics for identifying actionable molecular signatures. A multi-system transcriptomic study of Zika virus (ZIKV) integrates data from human brain organoids, monocyte-derived dendritic cells, and PBMCs from infected patients to map interferonstimulated gene (ISG) regulation across infection stages. IFN-β treatment potently activated ISGs including IRF7 and IFITM3 in brain organoids, while single-cell transcriptomics revealed cellular heterogeneity in ISG responses. Cross-system analysis identified 22 shared ISGs, and LASSO regression nominated 11 diagnostic biomarker candidates. Functional siRNA knockdown confirmed that IFI35, IFI44, and OAS3 restrict ZIKV replication, bridging transcriptomic discovery to validated antiviral mechanisms.A machine learning and mathematical modeling study of Ebola virus disease (EVD) resolves a longstanding controversy over the role of IFN-I in disease outcome. Analysis of patient data from the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic reveals that IFN-I responses precede symptom onset in survivors, whereas non-survivors mount equivalent responses 3-4 days later. This delay causes IFN-I and IL-12 signals to overlap in non-survivors, disrupting the sequential cytokine cues required for effective T cell activation. The findings elevate temporal immune dynamics as a critical yet underappreciated determinant of host protection versus pathology.An integrated metabolomics-transcriptomics study of dengue virus (DENV) infection profiles plasma from 41 patients and 23 healthy controls using LC-MS and GC-MS, identifying 197 differentially abundant metabolites. Top upregulated species including trans-cinnamic acid and Lacetylcarnitine are proposed as diagnostic biomarkers by ROC analysis. KEGG and GSEA analyses highlighted disruption of ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporters as a key metabolic perturbation, corroborated by transcriptomic integration from GEO datasets identifying ABCC5, ABCB1, and ABCG5 as hub targets, opening a new avenue for understanding DENV-induced cellular pathology.A longitudinal study of 157 COVID-19 patients examines expression of TLR7, TYK2, and OAS1 across disease severity groups. Low TLR7 expression robustly correlates with severity and viremia, while OAS1 persists in severe cases with high viral loads even as TLR7 declines during recovery. The interdependence of these innate immune genes highlights the coordinated yet severity-stratified nature of early antiviral responses to SARS-CoV-2 and has implications for prognostic stratification.A study examines how transcription factors EB (TFEB) and E3 (TFE3), master regulators of lysosomal biogenesis, modulate viral replication, autophagy, and apoptosis across three coronavirus genera: gamma coronavirus IBV, beta coronavirus HCoV-OC43, and alpha coronavirus PEDV. Infection upregulates TFEB/TFE3 and induces a lysosomal stress response. TFE3 knockdown reveals its predominant role in controlling replication and cell death, with synergistic TFEB/TFE3 effects in IBV-and HCoV-OC43-infected cells. Brefeldin A experiments further establish that HCoV-OC43 egress occurs via the lysosomal pathway, identifying TFEB/TFE3-governed lysosomal biology as a conserved host vulnerability across coronavirus genera.A transcriptomic investigation of African swine fever virus (ASFV) addresses its strict tropism for primary porcine alveolar macrophages (PAMs) versus limited replication in immortalized macrophage lines (iPAMs). Comparative profiling of the SY-1 strain reveals divergent host responses: iPAMs predominantly engage lipid metabolism and oxidative stress, whereas PAMs activate cytokine signaling and broad immune effector programs. Reduced replication in iPAMs thus reflects a fundamentally different cellular environment, not merely receptor availability. Functional validation identifies JPH4 and CYP1A1 as candidate host permissiveness factors, providing a foundation for improved in vitro models and antiviral strategies-critical given the absence of licensed ASF vaccines.Together, these seven articles demonstrate the power of integrated multi-omics and systems approaches to decode host-virus interactions. Cross-cutting themes include the centrality and context-dependence of IFN-I signaling, the importance of temporal immune dynamics, the utility of multi-omics integration for biomarker discovery, and the value of appropriate cell and patient models for mechanistic investigation. We thank all contributing authors and reviewers, and hope this collection advances the development of novel diagnostics and host-targeted therapeutics for viral infectious diseases.Keywords: host-virus interactions, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, interferon signaling, innate immunity, viral infectious diseases, systems biology, multi-omics

A clinical and proteomic analysis of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from 69 patients with varicella-zoster virus (VZV) CNS infection documents the predominant manifestations of headache, fever, and motor/sensory disturbances. CSF proteomics revealed markedly elevated protein abundance relative to controls, with upregulated proteins enriched in IFN-1 signaling, pyroptosis, and blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption pathways. Complement system overactivation in severe encephalitis cases emerged as a candidate marker of disease severity and a potential therapeutic target, underscoring the value of CSF proteomics for identifying actionable molecular signatures. A multi-system transcriptomic study of Zika virus (ZIKV) integrates data from human brain organoids, monocyte-derived dendritic cells, and PBMCs from infected patients to map interferonstimulated gene (ISG) regulation across infection stages. IFN-β treatment potently activated ISGs including IRF7 and IFITM3 in brain organoids, while single-cell transcriptomics revealed cellular heterogeneity in ISG responses. Cross-system analysis identified 22 shared ISGs, and LASSO regression nominated 11 diagnostic biomarker candidates. Functional siRNA knockdown confirmed that IFI35, IFI44, and OAS3 restrict ZIKV replication, bridging transcriptomic discovery to validated antiviral mechanisms.A machine learning and mathematical modeling study of Ebola virus disease (EVD) resolves a longstanding controversy over the role of IFN-I in disease outcome. Analysis of patient data from the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic reveals that IFN-I responses precede symptom onset in survivors, whereas non-survivors mount equivalent responses 3-4 days later. This delay causes IFN-I and IL-12 signals to overlap in non-survivors, disrupting the sequential cytokine cues required for effective T cell activation. The findings elevate temporal immune dynamics as a critical yet underappreciated determinant of host protection versus pathology.An integrated metabolomics-transcriptomics study of dengue virus (DENV) infection profiles plasma from 41 patients and 23 healthy controls using LC-MS and GC-MS, identifying 197 differentially abundant metabolites. Top upregulated species including trans-cinnamic acid and Lacetylcarnitine are proposed as diagnostic biomarkers by ROC analysis. KEGG and GSEA analyses highlighted disruption of ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporters as a key metabolic perturbation, corroborated by transcriptomic integration from GEO datasets identifying ABCC5, ABCB1, and ABCG5 as hub targets, opening a new avenue for understanding DENV-induced cellular pathology.A longitudinal study of 157 COVID-19 patients examines expression of TLR7, TYK2, and OAS1 across disease severity groups. Low TLR7 expression robustly correlates with severity and viremia, while OAS1 persists in severe cases with high viral loads even as TLR7 declines during recovery. The interdependence of these innate immune genes highlights the coordinated yet severity-stratified nature of early antiviral responses to SARS-CoV-2 and has implications for prognostic stratification.A study examines how transcription factors EB (TFEB) and E3 (TFE3), master regulators of lysosomal biogenesis, modulate viral replication, autophagy, and apoptosis across three coronavirus genera: gamma coronavirus IBV, beta coronavirus HCoV-OC43, and alpha coronavirus PEDV. Infection upregulates TFEB/TFE3 and induces a lysosomal stress response. TFE3 knockdown reveals its predominant role in controlling replication and cell death, with synergistic TFEB/TFE3 effects in IBV-and HCoV-OC43-infected cells. Brefeldin A experiments further establish that HCoV-OC43 egress occurs via the lysosomal pathway, identifying TFEB/TFE3-governed lysosomal biology as a conserved host vulnerability across coronavirus genera.A transcriptomic investigation of African swine fever virus (ASFV) addresses its strict tropism for primary porcine alveolar macrophages (PAMs) versus limited replication in immortalized macrophage lines (iPAMs). Comparative profiling of the SY-1 strain reveals divergent host responses: iPAMs predominantly engage lipid metabolism and oxidative stress, whereas PAMs activate cytokine signaling and broad immune effector programs. Reduced replication in iPAMs thus reflects a fundamentally different cellular environment, not merely receptor availability. Functional validation identifies JPH4 and CYP1A1 as candidate host permissiveness factors, providing a foundation for improved in vitro models and antiviral strategies-critical given the absence of licensed ASF vaccines.Together, these seven articles demonstrate the power of integrated multi-omics and systems approaches to decode host-virus interactions. Cross-cutting themes include the centrality and context-dependence of IFN-I signaling, the importance of temporal immune dynamics, the utility of multi-omics integration for biomarker discovery, and the value of appropriate cell and patient models for mechanistic investigation. We thank all contributing authors and reviewers, and hope this collection advances the development of novel diagnostics and host-targeted therapeutics for viral infectious diseases.Keywords: host-virus interactions, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, interferon signaling, innate immunity, viral infectious diseases, systems biology, multi-omics
